### Source

````html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
<title>VEPA4 — Solver Benchmark Report</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #07090e;
    --panel: #0d1118;
    --panel2: #111826;
    --line: #1c2432;
    --ink: #cfe0f2;
    --dim: #7d8ea6;
    --accent: #4fd1c5;
    --accent2: #f5a3b5;
    --accent3: #f7c873;
    --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0; padding: 24px;
    background:
      radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 70% -10%, rgba(79,209,197,.10), transparent 60%),
      var(--bg);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  /* ── Version mode switch ── */
  .mode-switch {
    position: absolute; top: 24px; right: 24px; z-index: 60;
    display: flex; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .mode-btn {
    padding: 7px 16px; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer;
    background: transparent; color: var(--dim); border: none;
    font-family: var(--mono); letter-spacing: .5px; white-space: nowrap;
    transition: color .15s, background .15s;
  }
  .mode-btn.active { background: rgba(79,209,197,.15); color: var(--accent); }
  .mode-btn:hover:not(.active) { color: var(--ink); }
  .mode-btn + .mode-btn { border-left: 1px solid var(--line); }
  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    .mode-switch { top: 14px; right: 14px; }
    .mode-btn { padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 12px; }
  }
  h1 { font-size: 18px; margin: 0 0 4px; letter-spacing: .5px; }
  h2 { font-size: 13px; margin: 32px 0 4px; color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .sub { color: var(--dim); margin-bottom: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }
  .meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; }
  .chip { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .chip b { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }

  /* ── Overview stat cards ── */
  .stat-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; max-width: 1000px; }
  .stat { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 14px; }
  .stat .k { color: var(--dim); font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .8px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .stat .v { font-size: 20px; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; }
  .stat .v small { font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); font-weight: 400; }
  .stat .d { font-size: 10px; color: var(--dim); margin-top: 5px; }
  .stat.hero { border-color: rgba(79,209,197,.45); box-shadow: inset 0 0 24px rgba(79,209,197,.05); }
  .stat.hero .v { color: var(--accent); }

  /* ── Chart ── */
  canvas.chart { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; margin: 10px 0 6px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; max-width: 1000px; }
  .chart-wrap { position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 1000px; min-width: 0; }
  .chart-tip {
    position: absolute; display: none; pointer-events: none; z-index: 5;
    background: rgba(13,17,24,.96); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.55; min-width: 150px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.5); white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .chart-tip .t-label { color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 3px; font-weight: 600; }
  .legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); }
  .legend span::before { content: "— "; font-weight: 700; }
  .legend .l-solid-teal::before { color: #4fd1c5; } .legend .l-dash-teal::before { content: "- - "; color: #4fd1c5; }
  .legend .l-solid-pink::before { color: #f5a3b5; } .legend .l-dash-pink::before { content: "- - "; color: #f5a3b5; }

  /* ── Tables (desktop matrix) ── */
  .table-wrap { width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
  table.matrix { border-collapse: collapse; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); min-width: 100%; }
  table.matrix th, table.matrix td {
    padding: 7px 10px; text-align: right; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap;
  }
  table.matrix th { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .5px; position: sticky; top: 0; background: var(--panel); z-index: 2; }
  table.matrix td:first-child, table.matrix th:first-child {
    text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; min-width: 190px; max-width: 260px;
    position: sticky; left: 0; background: var(--panel); z-index: 1; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--ink);
  }
  table.matrix th:first-child { z-index: 3; }
  tbody tr:hover td { background: rgba(79,209,197,.05); }
  tbody tr:hover td:first-child { background: var(--panel2); }
  td.best { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(79,209,197,.35); }
  td.worst { color: var(--accent2); }
  .dir { font-size: 10px; color: var(--dim); letter-spacing: .4px; }
  .metric-head { margin: 18px 0 6px; font-size: 11.5px; }
  .metric-head b { color: var(--ink); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .8px; font-size: 11px; }

  /* ── Mobile metric cards ── */
  .mobile-only { display: none; }
  .m-card { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; margin: 10px 0; max-width: 520px; }
  .m-card .m-title { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .8px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .m-card .m-dir { font-size: 10px; color: var(--dim); margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .m-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 0; font-size: 12px; }
  .m-row .m-k { width: 64px; color: var(--dim); flex-shrink: 0; }
  .m-row .m-bar { flex: 1; height: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; }
  .m-row .m-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 2px; }
  .m-row.slow .m-bar i { background: var(--accent2); }
  .m-row .m-v { width: 128px; text-align: right; flex-shrink: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .m-row .m-v small { color: var(--dim); }
  details.m-all summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--accent); font-size: 11px; padding: 6px 0 0; user-select: none; }

  /* ── Configuration cards ── */
  .grid2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
  .grid3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
  .card { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; min-width: 0; }
  .card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink); letter-spacing: .5px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .badge { font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid rgba(79,209,197,.45); padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 4px; }
  .cfg-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 4px 0; font-size: 12px; }
  .cfg-row .ck { color: var(--dim); }
  .score-track { height: 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; margin: 10px 0 4px; }
  .score-fill { height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent3)); border-radius: 3px; }

  /* ── Bars ── */
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  .bar-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 2px 0; padding: 3px 0; min-height: 26px; }
  .bar-label { width: 110px; text-align: right; font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); flex-shrink: 0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .bar-track { flex: 1; height: 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.03); border-radius: 3px; overflow: visible; position: relative; }
  .bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 3px; transition: width .3s ease; }
  .bar-marker { position: absolute; top: -3px; bottom: -3px; width: 2px; background: rgba(247,200,115,.85); z-index: 2; box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(247,200,115,.5); }
  .bar-value { width: 132px; text-align: left; font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink); flex-shrink: 0; white-space: nowrap; }

  /* ── Sticky anchor nav ── */
  #topnav {
    position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50;
    display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    background: rgba(7,9,14,.94); backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
    padding: 10px 0; margin: -24px 0 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  #topnav a {
    flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--dim); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .6px;
    padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px;
    transition: color .15s, border-color .15s;
  }
  #topnav a:hover { color: var(--accent); border-color: rgba(79,209,197,.5); }

  /* ── Collapsible sections ── */
  details.section { margin-top: 28px; }
  details.section > summary {
    cursor: pointer; list-style: none; user-select: none;
    font-size: 13px; color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 0;
    min-height: 32px;
  }
  details.section > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
  details.section > summary::before { content: "▸"; color: var(--dim); transition: transform .15s; font-size: 11px; }
  details.section[open] > summary::before { transform: rotate(90deg); }
  details.section[open] > summary { margin-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }

  .law-cat { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; margin-right: 5px; vertical-align: middle; }
  .note { color: var(--dim); font-size: 11px; margin-top: 28px; line-height: 1.6; }
  .warn { color: var(--accent2); }

  /* ── Compare mode: dual-panel layout ── */
  .compare-panel { display: none; }
  .compare-mode .compare-panel { display: block; }
  .compare-mode .single-panel { display: none; }
  .compare-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
  @media (max-width: 760px) { .compare-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .compare-col { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; min-width: 0; }
  .compare-col h3 { font-size: 13px; margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--ink); }
  .compare-col .v800 { color: #f87171; }
  .compare-col .v816 { color: var(--accent); }
  .delta-pos { color: #f87171; }
  .delta-neg { color: var(--accent); }
  .compare-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 11.5px; }
  .compare-table th, .compare-table td { padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .compare-table th { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; text-align: right; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .compare-table th:first-child, .compare-table td:first-child { text-align: left; }

  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    body { padding: 14px; font-size: 13px; }
    .desktop-only { display: none !important; }
    .mobile-only { display: block !important; }
    details.section { margin-top: 22px; }
    #topnav { margin: -14px 0 16px; padding: 8px 0; }
    #topnav a { font-size: 12px; padding: 8px 13px; }
    /* Minimum 12px legibility everywhere */
    .dir { font-size: 12px !important; }
    .chip { font-size: 12px; }
    .chip b { font-size: 12.5px; }
    .stat .v { font-size: 17px; }
    .m-row { font-size: 13px; padding: 5px 0; min-height: 30px; }
    .m-card .m-title { font-size: 12px; }
    .card h3 { font-size: 12.5px; }
    .bar-label { width: 104px; font-size: 12px; }
    .bar-value { width: 122px; font-size: 12px; }
    .bar-track { height: 20px; }
    .bar-row { min-height: 34px; padding: 4px 0; gap: 10px; }
    table.matrix th, table.matrix td { font-size: 12.5px; padding: 8px 10px; }
    .cfg-row { font-size: 13px; padding: 5px 0; }
    details.m-all summary { font-size: 12px; padding: 8px 0 0; min-height: 30px; }
    .legend { font-size: 12px; }
    .note { font-size: 12px; }
    .grid2, .grid3 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="mode-switch" id="modeswitch">
    <button class="mode-btn" data-mode="v800">v8.0</button>
    <button class="mode-btn" data-mode="compare">Compare</button>
    <button class="mode-btn active" data-mode="current">v8.16</button>
  </div>
  <nav id="topnav">
    <a href="#sec-overview">Overview</a>
    <a href="#sec-performance">Performance</a>
    <a href="#sec-scaling">Scaling</a>
    <a href="#sec-configs">Configs</a>
    <a href="#sec-ablation">Per-law</a>
    <a href="#sec-categories">Categories</a>
    <a href="#sec-knobs">Knob matrix</a>
    <a href="#sec-sweeps">Sweeps</a>
  </nav>
  <h1>Benchmark Report</h1>
  <div class="sub" id="headline"></div>
  <div class="sub dir">Tap the section titles (or the pills above) to expand each analysis — Overview, Performance and Scaling start open.</div>

  <!-- COMPARE PANEL: visible only when Compare mode is active -->
  <div id="compare-view" class="compare-panel" style="margin-bottom:24px">
    <h2 style="margin-top:0">v8.0 → v8.16 Comparison</h2>
    <div class="sub">Side-by-side at common population scales. v8.0 data captured from git tag v8.0.0 (pre-optimisation solver); v8.16 data from current HEAD (v8.16.12 — grid fix + allocation-free hot path).</div>
    <div class="compare-grid" style="margin-top:12px">
      <div class="compare-col">
        <h3>Throughput · <span class="v800">v8.0</span> vs <span class="v816">v8.16</span></h3>
        <canvas id="compare-chart" width="520" height="280" style="width:100%;height:auto;background:none;border:0;margin:0"></canvas>
      </div>
      <div class="compare-col" id="compare-stats"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="table-wrap" style="margin-top:14px"><table class="compare-table" id="compare-tbl"></table></div>
    <div class="mobile-only" id="compare-mobile"></div>
  </div>

  <details class="section" id="sec-overview" open><summary>Overview</summary>
  <div class="stat-grid" id="overview"></div>
  <div id="meta" class="meta" style="margin-top:14px"></div>

  </details>

  <details class="section" id="sec-performance" open><summary>Performance</summary>
  <div class="legend">
    <span class="l-solid-teal">Main · 10 laws</span>
    <span class="l-dash-teal">Worker · 10 laws</span>
    <span class="l-solid-pink">Main · 128 laws</span>
    <span class="l-dash-pink">Worker · 128 laws</span>
  </div>
  <div class="sub dir">Throughput · frames per second · ↑ higher is better · profiles stop below 15 fps</div>
  <div class="chart-wrap">
    <canvas id="scaling" class="chart" width="1000" height="320"></canvas>
    <div class="chart-tip" id="scaling-tip"></div>
  </div>

  </details>

  <details class="section" id="sec-scaling" open><summary>Detailed results — population scaling</summary>
  <div class="desktop-only">
    <table class="matrix" id="scaling-table"></table>
    <div class="sub dir" style="margin-top:6px">Scroll horizontally for more scales · best value per row outlined in teal · RTT = cold worker round-trip</div>
  </div>
  <div class="mobile-only" id="scaling-mobile"></div>

  </details>

  <details class="section" id="sec-configs"><summary>Configurations</summary>
  <div class="sub">Each configuration compared at a common reference scale. Score = fps relative to the fastest configuration.</div>
  <div class="grid2" id="config-cards"></div>

  </details>

  <details class="section" id="sec-ablation"><summary>Per-law ablation — vs ALL 128 laws</summary>
  <div class="sub">Ablation at N=<span id="perlaw-n">—</span> particles. Each row answers: <i>how much does this law cost, and what does removing it change?</i> <b>Solo Cost</b> = a full tick with only that law enabled. <b>Without Law</b> = the all-128 tick with that law removed. <b>Δ Runtime / Δ %</b> = ALL 128 − Without Law (the law's marginal cost, absolute and proportional). <span class="warn">Δ % rows do not sum to 100%</span>: laws interact — with all 128 on, force/chemistry laws clump particles and saturate the pairwise loop, so removing several at once saves less than the sum of individual removals.</div>
  <div id="perlaw-summary" class="meta"></div>
  <h3 style="font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;margin:16px 0 6px">Marginal cost by law · ↓ lower is cheaper · <span style="color:var(--accent3)">┃</span> median marker</h3>
  <div id="perlaw-bars"></div>
  <div class="desktop-only"><table class="matrix" id="perlaw-table"></table></div>
  <div class="mobile-only" id="perlaw-mobile"></div>

  </details>

  <details class="section" id="sec-categories"><summary>Per-law by category</summary>
  <div class="grid3" id="category-cards"></div>
  </details>

  <details class="section" id="sec-knobs"><summary>Tuning-knob matrix</summary>
  <div class="sub dir">Latency · ms/frame · ↓ lower is better · teal = fast, pink = slow</div>
  <div class="table-wrap"><table class="matrix" id="matrix" style="min-width:420px"></table></div>

  </details>

  <details class="section" id="sec-sweeps"><summary>Knob sweeps</summary>
  <div class="grid2" id="sweeps"></div>
  </details>

  <div class="note" id="foot"></div>

<script>
  // ── v8.0.0 benchmark snapshot (pre-optimisation solver, 2026-08-18) ──
  // Captured with: node bench/solver.bench.mjs --particles ... --all --json
  window.V800_DATA = {
    generatedAt: "2026-08-18T00:00:00.000Z",
    solver: { lawCount: 128, particleStride: 100, defaultLaws: ["GRAV","DRAG","ENTR","WRAP","COLL","LIFE","GLOW","REPRO","PHENOTYPE","GENOTYPE"] },
    reportParams: { count: 500, rounds: 1 },
    baseline: { GRID_DIM: 12, CELL_CAP: 500, MAX_INTERACTIONS: 500, NEIGHBOR_BUF: 256 },
    // 128-law scaling (all laws active)
    scalingAll: [
      { count:500,  msPerTick:94.68,  ticksPerSec:10.6 },
      { count:1000, msPerTick:74.81,  ticksPerSec:13.4 },
      { count:2500, msPerTick:290.02, ticksPerSec:3.4  },
      { count:5000, msPerTick:934.52, ticksPerSec:1.1  },
      { count:10000,msPerTick:3185.47,ticksPerSec:0.3  },
    ],
    workerScalingAll: [],
    // 10-law scaling (default PRIME_DEFAULT laws)
    scaling: [
      { count:500,  msPerTick:1.004, ticksPerSec:995.8 },
      { count:1000, msPerTick:1.621, ticksPerSec:616.9 },
      { count:2500, msPerTick:3.624, ticksPerSec:275.9 },
      { count:5000, msPerTick:7.082, ticksPerSec:141.2 },
      { count:10000,msPerTick:13.764,ticksPerSec:72.7  },
      { count:25000,msPerTick:33.169,ticksPerSec:30.1  },
    ],
    workerScaling: [],
    perLaw: [], matrix: null, gridDim: null, cellCap: null, maxInteractions: null, neighborBuf: null,
    categories: {},
  };
</script>
<script src="./data.js"></script>
<script>
  // ── Version mode switching ──────────────────────────────────────
  const V800 = window.V800_DATA;
  const VCUR = window.BENCH_DATA;
  let VERSION_MODE = 'current';
  let D = VCUR;

  function switchMode(mode) {
    VERSION_MODE = mode;
    D = mode === 'v800' ? V800 : VCUR;
    document.querySelectorAll('.mode-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.mode === mode));
    // In compare mode, show both datasets side-by-side.
    document.body.classList.toggle('compare-mode', mode === 'compare');
    renderAll();
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.mode-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => switchMode(btn.dataset.mode));
  });

  const fmt = (n, d = 2) => Number(n).toFixed(d);
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // ── Main render: rebuilds the entire SPA for the active dataset ──
  function renderAll() {

  // ── Series model ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const CONFIGS = [
    { key: 'main10',   name: 'Main · 10 laws',  short: 'Main 10',  data: D.scaling,          color: '#4fd1c5', dash: null,     worker: false },
    { key: 'worker10', name: 'Worker · 10 laws',short: 'Worker 10',data: D.workerScaling,    color: '#4fd1c5', dash: [6, 4],   worker: true },
    { key: 'main128',  name: 'Main · 128 laws', short: 'Main 128', data: D.scalingAll,       color: '#f5a3b5', dash: null,     worker: false },
    { key: 'worker128',name: 'Worker · 128 laws',short:'Worker 128',data: D.workerScalingAll,color: '#f5a3b5', dash: [6, 4],   worker: true },
  ].filter(c => Array.isArray(c.data) && c.data.length);
  const msOf = (r) => r.msPerTick ?? (r.solverUs != null ? r.solverUs / 1000 : NaN);
  const fpsOf = (r) => (msOf(r) > 0 ? 1000 / msOf(r) : 0);
  const median = (arr) => { const a = [...arr].sort((x, y) => x - y); const m = Math.floor(a.length / 2); return a.length % 2 ? a[m] : (a[m - 1] + a[m]) / 2; };

  // Reference scale: largest particle count present in EVERY measured config.
  let refCount = null;
  if (CONFIGS.length) {
    refCount = Math.max(...CONFIGS.map(c => Math.min(...c.data.map(r => r.count))));
    while (!CONFIGS.every(c => c.data.some(r => r.count === refCount)) && refCount > 500) refCount -= 500;
  }
  const atScale = (c, n) => c.data.find(r => r.count === n);

  // ── Headline + meta chips ──────────────────────────────────────
  const totalScales = new Set(CONFIGS.flatMap(c => c.data.map(r => r.count))).size;
  $('headline').innerHTML =
    `${totalScales} population scales · ${D.solver.lawCount}-law exhaustive profile · ${CONFIGS.map(c => c.short).join(' · ')}` +
    ` — regenerate with <code>node bench/solver.bench.mjs --all</code>`;
  const chips = [
    ['Generated', new Date(D.generatedAt).toLocaleString()],
    ['Per-law N', D.reportParams.perLawCount || D.reportParams.count],
    ['Rounds', D.reportParams.rounds],
    ['Stride', D.solver.particleStride],
    ['Worker', D.solver.workerMode || 'not recorded'],
    ['Baseline knobs', `GRID ${D.baseline.GRID_DIM} · CELLCAP ${D.baseline.CELL_CAP} · MAXINT ${D.baseline.MAX_INTERACTIONS} · NBUF ${D.baseline.NEIGHBOR_BUF}`],
  ];
  $('meta').innerHTML = chips.map(([k, v]) => `<span class="chip">${k}: <b>${v}</b></span>`).join('');

  // ── Compare mode: v8.0 vs v8.16 dual-panel ─────────────────────
  (function renderCompare() {
    const view = $('compare-view');
    if (!view || !V800 || !VCUR) return;
    // Compare 10-law scaling (both have it).
    const v8s = V800.scaling || [], v16s = VCUR.scaling || [];
    if (!v8s.length || !v16s.length) return;

    // Match common scales.
    const common = v8s.filter(r8 => v16s.some(r16 => r16.count === r8.count));
    const get16 = (n) => v16s.find(r => r.count === n);
    const fpsOf = (r) => r.msPerTick > 0 ? 1000 / r.msPerTick : 0;

    // Stats card.
    const scales = common.map(r => r.count);
    const g16 = get16(Math.max(...scales));
    const g8 = common.find(r => r.count === Math.max(...scales));
    const speedup = g8 && g16 ? (fpsOf(g16) / fpsOf(g8) - 1) * 100 : 0;
    const medSpeedup = common.length ? (() => {
      const ratios = common.map(r8 => { const r16 = get16(r8.count); return r16 ? fpsOf(r16) / Math.max(fpsOf(r8), 0.1) : 1; });
      return (median(ratios) - 1) * 100;
    })() : 0;
    $('compare-stats').innerHTML =
      `<div class="stat hero" style="margin-bottom:10px"><div class="k">★ Speedup at ${(g8?.count || '??').toLocaleString()} particles</div>
       <div class="v" style="color:${speedup >= 0 ? 'var(--accent)':'var(--accent2)'}">${speedup >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${fmt(speedup, 1)}%</div>
       <div class="d">${g8 ? fmt(fpsOf(g8),1) : '—'} → ${g16 ? fmt(fpsOf(g16),1) : '—'} fps (10-law main thread)</div></div>` +
      `<div class="stat"><div class="k">Median speedup</div><div class="v">${medSpeedup >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${fmt(medSpeedup, 1)}%</div><div class="d">Across ${common.length} common scales</div></div>` +
      `<div class="stat"><div class="k">Common scales</div><div class="v">${common.length}</div><div class="d">${Math.min(...common.map(r=>r.count)).toLocaleString()} – ${Math.max(...common.map(r=>r.count)).toLocaleString()} particles</div></div>`;

    // Compare chart.
    const canvas = $('compare-chart');
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
    const pad = { l: 60, r: 16, t: 16, b: 38 };
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    const plotW = W - pad.l - pad.r, plotH = H - pad.t - pad.b;
    const labels = scales.map(n => n < 1000 ? String(n) : `${(n/1000)|0}k`);
    const v8vals = common.map(r => fpsOf(r));
    const v16vals = common.map(r => { const r16 = get16(r.count); return r16 ? fpsOf(r16) : 0; });
    const allVals = [...v8vals, ...v16vals];
    let maxV = Math.max(...allVals, 1) * 1.1;
    const x = (i) => pad.l + (i / Math.max(1, common.length - 1)) * plotW;
    const y = (v) => pad.t + plotH - (v / maxV) * plotH;

    // Gridlines.
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.06)'; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(125,142,166,.85)';
    ctx.font = '10px ' + getComputedStyle(document.body).fontFamily; ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    for (let g = 0; g <= 4; g++) {
      const gy = pad.t + (g / 4) * plotH;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad.l, gy); ctx.lineTo(W - pad.r, gy); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillText(`${(maxV * (1 - g / 4)).toFixed(0)} fps`, pad.l - 6, gy + 3);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    const tickIdx = (n, t) => { if (n <= t + 1) return [...Array(n).keys()]; const s = new Set([0, n-1]); for (let g = 1; g < t-1; g++) s.add(Math.round(g/(t-1)*(n-1))); return [...s].sort((a,b)=>a-b); };
    for (const i of tickIdx(common.length, 6)) ctx.fillText(labels[i], x(i), H - pad.b + 18);

    // Draw lines.
    const drawSeries = (vals, color, dash) => {
      ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.setLineDash(dash || []);
      ctx.beginPath(); vals.forEach((v, i) => (i ? ctx.lineTo(x(i), y(v)) : ctx.moveTo(x(i), y(v)))); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
      vals.forEach((v, i) => { ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x(i), y(v), 3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); });
    };
    drawSeries(v8vals, '#f87171', [4,4]);
    drawSeries(v16vals, '#4fd1c5', null);
    // Legend.
    ctx.font = '10px ' + getComputedStyle(document.body).fontFamily; ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f87171'; ctx.fillText('—   v8.0 (pre-optimisation)', pad.l + 6, pad.t + 16);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4fd1c5'; ctx.fillText('—   v8.16 (current)', pad.l + 6, pad.t + 32);

    // Comparison table.
    let thtml = '<thead><tr><th>Scale</th><th>v8.0 ms/frame</th><th>v8.16 ms/frame</th><th>Δ ms</th><th>Speedup</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    for (const r8 of common) {
      const r16 = get16(r8.count);
      const ms8 = r8.msPerTick, ms16 = r16 ? r16.msPerTick : NaN;
      const delta = isNaN(ms16) ? NaN : ms16 - ms8;
      const sp = isNaN(ms16) || ms8 <= 0 ? NaN : (1000 / ms16) / (1000 / ms8) - 1;
      const isFaster = delta < 0;
      thtml += `<tr><td>${r8.count.toLocaleString()}</td>` +
        `<td><span class="v800">${fmt(ms8)}</span></td>` +
        `<td><span class="v816">${isNaN(ms16) ? '—' : fmt(ms16)}</span></td>` +
        `<td class="${!isNaN(delta) ? (isFaster ? 'delta-neg' : 'delta-pos') : ''}">${isNaN(delta) ? '—' : (isFaster ? fmt(delta) : '+' + fmt(delta))}</td>` +
        `<td class="${!isNaN(sp) ? (sp > 0 ? 'delta-neg' : 'delta-pos') : ''}">${isNaN(sp) ? '—' : (sp >= 0 ? '↑' : '↓') + fmt(Math.abs(sp) * 100, 1) + '%'}</td></tr>`;
    }
    thtml += '</tbody>';
    $('compare-tbl').innerHTML = thtml;

    // Mobile cards.
    $('compare-mobile').innerHTML = common.map(r8 => {
      const r16 = get16(r8.count);
      const ms8 = r8.msPerTick, ms16 = r16 ? r16.msPerTick : 0;
      const sp = ms8 > 0 && ms16 > 0 ? (1000 / ms16) / (1000 / ms8) - 1 : 0;
      return `<div class="m-card"><div class="m-title">${r8.count.toLocaleString()} particles</div>
        <div class="m-row"><span class="m-k">v8.0</span><span class="m-v v800">${fmt(ms8)} ms/frame</span></div>
        <div class="m-row"><span class="m-k">v8.16</span><span class="m-v v816">${fmt(ms16)} ms/frame</span></div>
        <div class="m-row"><span class="m-k">Speedup</span><span class="m-v" style="color:${sp>=0?'var(--accent)':'var(--accent2)'}">${sp>=0?'+':''}${fmt(sp*100,1)}%</span></div></div>`;
    }).join('');
  })();

  // ── Level 1: Executive overview ────────────────────────────────
  (function overview() {
    const stats = [];
    // Best configuration at the common reference scale.
    if (refCount) {
      const ranked = CONFIGS
        .map(c => ({ c, r: atScale(c, refCount) }))
        .filter(x => x.r)
        .sort((a, b) => msOf(a.r) - msOf(b.r));
      const best = ranked[0];
      if (best) stats.push({ hero: true, k: '★ Best configuration', v: best.c.name, d: `${fmt(msOf(best.r))} ms/frame · ${fmt(fpsOf(best.r), 1)} fps @ ${refCount.toLocaleString()} particles` });
      // Worker improvement over main at the same scale & law set.
      for (const laws of ['10 laws', '128 laws']) {
        const main = ranked.find(x => x.c.name.includes('Main') && x.c.name.includes(laws));
        const wk = ranked.find(x => x.c.name.includes('Worker') && x.c.name.includes(laws));
        if (main && wk && msOf(main.r) > 0) {
          const gain = (1 - msOf(wk.r) / msOf(main.r)) * 100;
          stats.push({ k: `Worker improvement (${laws})`, v: (gain >= 0 ? '+' : '') + fmt(gain, 1) + '%', d: `${fmt(msOf(wk.r))} vs ${fmt(msOf(main.r))} ms/frame` });
        }
      }
    }
    const main10 = D.scaling || [];
    if (main10.length) {
      stats.push({ k: 'Median latency', v: fmt(median(main10.map(msOf))) + '<small> ms</small>', d: 'Main · 10 laws across ' + main10.length + ' scales' });
      stats.push({ k: 'Peak throughput', v: fmt(Math.max(...main10.map(fpsOf)), 1) + '<small> fps</small>', d: '@ ' + main10.reduce((b, r) => (fpsOf(r) > fpsOf(b) ? r : b)).count.toLocaleString() + ' particles' });
      const last60 = main10.filter(r => fpsOf(r) >= 60).map(r => r.count);
      stats.push({ k: 'Max N ≥ 60 fps', v: last60.length ? Math.max(...last60).toLocaleString() : '—<small></small>', d: 'Main · 10 laws · real-time budget' });
    }
    // Stability from knob-sweep spreads.
    const sweepsArr = ['gridDim', 'cellCap', 'maxInteractions', 'neighborBuf'].map(k => D[k]).filter(Boolean);
    if (sweepsArr.length) {
      const allPts = sweepsArr.flat();
      const spread = allPts.reduce((s, r) => s + ((r.maxMs - r.minMs) / r.msPerTick), 0) / allPts.length;
      stats.push({ k: 'Stability', v: fmt(Math.max(0, (1 - spread)) * 100, 1) + '%', d: '1 − mean relative spread across knob sweeps' });
    }
    $('overview').innerHTML = stats.map(s =>
      `<div class="stat${s.hero ? ' hero' : ''}"><div class="k">${s.k}</div><div class="v">${s.v}</div><div class="d">${s.d}</div></div>`
    ).join('');
  })();

  // ── Chart engine: sparse ticks + crosshair tooltip ─────────────
  function tickIdx(n, target = 6) {
    if (n <= target + 1) return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => i);
    const out = new Set([0, n - 1]);
    for (let g = 1; g < target - 1; g++) out.add(Math.round((g / (target - 1)) * (n - 1)));
    return [...out].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  }
  function drawLine(canvas, labels, series, opts = {}) {
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
    const pad = { l: 56, r: 16, t: 18, b: 34 };
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    const plotW = W - pad.l - pad.r, plotH = H - pad.t - pad.b;
    let max = 0;
    for (const s of series) for (const v of s.values) max = Math.max(max, v);
    max = max * 1.08 || 1;
    const n = labels.length;
    const x = (i) => pad.l + (i / Math.max(1, n - 1)) * plotW;
    const y = (v) => pad.t + plotH - (v / max) * plotH;

    // 60 fps target line when plotting throughput.
    if (opts.fps && max > 66) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(247,200,115,.35)';
      ctx.setLineDash([3, 5]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad.l, y(60)); ctx.lineTo(W - pad.r, y(60)); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(247,200,115,.7)'; ctx.font = '9px ' + getComputedStyle(document.body).fontFamily;
      ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.fillText('60 fps target', pad.l + 4, y(60) - 4);
    }
    // gridlines + sparse x ticks
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.06)';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(125,142,166,.85)';
    ctx.font = '10px ' + getComputedStyle(document.body).fontFamily;
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    for (let g = 0; g <= 4; g++) {
      const gy = pad.t + (g / 4) * plotH;
      const val = max - (g / 4) * max;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad.l, gy); ctx.lineTo(W - pad.r, gy); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillText(opts.fps ? `${fmt(val, 0)} fps` : fmt(val, 1), pad.l - 6, gy + 3);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    for (const i of tickIdx(n)) ctx.fillText(labels[i], x(i), H - pad.b + 16);

    series.forEach((s) => {
      ctx.strokeStyle = s.color; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.setLineDash(s.dash || []);
      ctx.beginPath();
      s.values.forEach((v, i) => (i ? ctx.lineTo(x(i), y(v)) : ctx.moveTo(x(i), y(v))));
      ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
      s.values.forEach((v, i) => { ctx.fillStyle = s.color; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x(i), y(v), 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); });
    });

    // Tooltip wiring (pointer → nearest scale).
    const wrapEl = canvas.parentElement;
    const tip = opts.tipId ? $(opts.tipId) : null;
    if (!tip) return;
    canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (ev) => {
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const px = (ev.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
      let bi = 0, bd = Infinity;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const dx = Math.abs(x(i) - px); if (dx < bd) { bd = dx; bi = i; } }
      tip.innerHTML = `<div class="t-label">${labels[bi]} particles</div>` +
        series.map(s => `<div><span style="color:${s.color}">${s.name}</span>: ${opts.fps ? fmt(s.values[bi], 1) + ' fps' : fmt(s.values[bi]) + ' ms'}</div>`).join('');
      tip.style.display = 'block';
      const wr = wrapEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      let tx = ev.clientX - wr.left + 14, ty = ev.clientY - wr.top - 10;
      if (tx + tip.offsetWidth > wr.width - 4) tx = ev.clientX - wr.left - tip.offsetWidth - 14;
      tip.style.left = tx + 'px'; tip.style.top = ty + 'px';
    });
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { tip.style.display = 'none'; });
  }

  // Primary chart — FPS axis (higher is better).
  if (D.scaling) {
    drawLine($('scaling'),
      D.scaling.map(r => r.count.toLocaleString()),
      CONFIGS.map(c => ({
        name: c.name,
        values: c.data.map(r => fpsOf(r)),
        color: c.color,
        dash: c.dash,
      })),
      { fps: true, tipId: 'scaling-tip' });
  }

  // ── Level 3a: Desktop scaling matrix (heat-encoded) ────────────
  function heatStyle(v, lo, hi, invert) {
    if (!(hi > lo)) return '';
    const t = (v - lo) / (hi - lo);            // 0 = best, 1 = worst
    const q = invert ? t : 1 - t;              // teal intensity toward best
    return `background:rgba(${q > 0.5 ? '79,209,197' : '245,163,181'},${(Math.abs(q - 0.5) * 0.22 + 0.03).toFixed(3)})`;
  }
  (function scalingMatrix() {
    if (!D.scaling) return;
    const counts = [...new Set(CONFIGS.flatMap(c => c.data.map(r => r.count)))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const get = (c, n) => atScale(c, n);
    const st = $('scaling-table');
    const rowDefs = [
      { title: 'Main workload · 10 laws', unit: 'ms/frame', dir: false, cfgKey: 'main10' },
      { title: 'Worker workload · 10 laws', unit: 'ms/frame', dir: false, cfgKey: 'worker10' },
      { title: 'Main workload · 128 laws', unit: 'ms/frame', dir: false, cfgKey: 'main128' },
      { title: 'Worker workload · 128 laws', unit: 'ms/frame', dir: false, cfgKey: 'worker128' },
    ];
    let html = '<thead><tr><th>Metric ↓ lower is better</th>' +
      counts.map(n => `<th>${n.toLocaleString()}</th>`).join('') + '</tr></thead><tbody>';
    for (const rd of rowDefs) {
      const cfg = CONFIGS.find(c => c.key === rd.cfgKey);
      if (!cfg) continue;
      const vals = counts.map(n => { const r = get(cfg, n); return r ? msOf(r) : null; });
      const nums = vals.filter(v => v != null);
      const lo = Math.min(...nums), hi = Math.max(...nums);
      const bestV = lo;
      html += `<tr><td>${rd.title}<br><span class="dir">${rd.unit} · ↓ lower is better</span></td>` +
        vals.map(v => v == null ? '<td>—</td>' :
          `<td class="${v === bestV ? 'best' : ''}" style="${heatStyle(v, lo, hi)}">${fmt(v)}</td>`).join('') + '</tr>';
    }
    // Derived rows: worker RTT and fps equivalent.
    for (const cfg of CONFIGS.filter(c => c.worker)) {
      const vals = counts.map(n => { const r = get(cfg, n); return r && r.roundTripUs != null ? r.roundTripUs / 1000 : null; });
      if (vals.every(v => v == null)) continue;
      const nums = vals.filter(v => v != null);
      const lo = Math.min(...nums), hi = Math.max(...nums);
      html += `<tr><td>${cfg.name} cold RTT<br><span class="dir">ms/request · ↓ lower is better</span></td>` +
        vals.map(v => v == null ? '<td>—</td>' :
          `<td style="${heatStyle(v, lo, hi)}">${fmt(v)}</td>`).join('') + '</tr>';
    }
    const mainCfg = CONFIGS.find(c => c.key === 'main10');
    const fvals = counts.map(n => { const r = get(mainCfg, n); return r ? fpsOf(r) : null; });
    const fnums = fvals.filter(v => v != null);
    html += `<tr><td>Main workload · 10 laws<br><span class="dir">throughput · fps · ↑ higher is better</span></td>` +
      fvals.map(v => v == null ? '<td>—</td>' :
        `<td class="${v === Math.max(...fnums) ? 'best' : ''}" style="background:rgba(79,209,197,${(0.05 + 0.25 * (v / Math.max(...fnums))).toFixed(3)})">${fmt(v, 1)}</td>`).join('') + '</tr>';
    html += '</tbody>';
    st.innerHTML = html;
  })();

  // ── Level 3b: Mobile per-metric ranked cards ───────────────────
  (function scalingMobile() {
    if (!D.scaling) return;
    const el = $('scaling-mobile');
    let html = '';
    for (const cfg of CONFIGS) {
      const pts = [...cfg.data].sort((a, b) => msOf(a) - msOf(b));
      const maxMs = Math.max(...pts.map(msOf));
      html += `<div class="m-card">
        <div class="m-title">${cfg.name}</div>
        <div class="m-dir">latency · ms/frame · ↓ lower is better · sorted fastest first</div>` +
        pts.slice(0, 6).map(r => {
          const ms = msOf(r), f = fpsOf(r);
          return `<div class="m-row${ms === maxMs ? ' slow' : ''}">
            <span class="m-k">${r.count.toLocaleString()}</span>
            <span class="m-bar"><i style="width:${(100 - (ms / maxMs) * 92).toFixed(1)}%;opacity:${(0.35 + 0.65 * (1 - ms / maxMs)).toFixed(2)}"></i></span>
            <span class="m-v">${fmt(ms)} ms <small>· ${fmt(f, 0)} fps</small></span></div>`;
        }).join('') +
        `<details class="m-all"><summary>Show all ${pts.length} scales</summary>` +
        pts.slice(6).map(r => {
          const ms = msOf(r);
          return `<div class="m-row${ms === maxMs ? ' slow' : ''}">
            <span class="m-k">${r.count.toLocaleString()}</span>
            <span class="m-bar"><i style="width:${(100 - (ms / maxMs) * 92).toFixed(1)}%;opacity:.5"></i></span>
            <span class="m-v">${fmt(ms)} ms <small>· ${fmt(fpsOf(r), 0)} fps</small></span></div>`;
        }).join('') + '</details></div>';
    }
    el.innerHTML = html;
  })();

  // ── Configuration cards (both breakpoints) ─────────────────────
  (function configCards() {
    if (!refCount) return;
    const rowsAtRef = CONFIGS.map(c => ({ c, r: atScale(c, refCount) })).filter(x => x.r);
    const maxFps = Math.max(...rowsAtRef.map(x => fpsOf(x.r)));
    const bestKey = rowsAtRef.sort((a, b) => msOf(a.r) - msOf(b.r))[0].c.key;
    $('config-cards').innerHTML = rowsAtRef.map(({ c, r }) => {
      const ms = msOf(r), f = fpsOf(r);
      const score = (f / maxFps) * 100;
      return `<div class="card">
        <h3>${c.name}${c.key === bestKey ? ' <span class="badge">★ BEST</span>' : ''}</h3>
        <div class="cfg-row"><span class="ck">Particles</span><span>${refCount.toLocaleString()}</span></div>
        <div class="cfg-row"><span class="ck">Latency</span><span>${fmt(ms)} ms/frame</span></div>
        <div class="cfg-row"><span class="ck">Throughput</span><span>${fmt(f, 1)} fps</span></div>` +
        (c.worker && r.roundTripUs != null ? `<div class="cfg-row"><span class="ck">Cold RTT</span><span>${fmt(r.roundTripUs / 1000)} ms</span></div>` : '') +
        `<div class="score-track"><div class="score-fill" style="width:${score.toFixed(1)}%"></div></div>
        <div class="cfg-row"><span class="ck">Score</span><span>${fmt(score, 1)}</span></div>
      </div>`;
    }).join('');
  })();

  // ── Per-law ablation ───────────────────────────────────────────
  const CAT_COLORS = {
    'PHYSICS': '#ef4444', 'BIOLOGY': '#f97316', 'CHEMISTRY': '#eab308',
    'THERMODYNAMICS': '#22c55e', 'METAPHYSICS': '#14b8a6', 'ELECTROMAGNETISM': '#3b82f6',
    'INFORMATION': '#8b5cf6', 'QUANTUM': '#a855f7',
  };
  const isAnchorLaw = (l) => l === 'ALL_DEFAULT' || l === 'ZERO_LAWS' || l === 'ALL_128' || l === 'ALL';

  if (D.perLaw && D.perLaw.length) {
    const perLawN = D.reportParams.perLawCount || D.reportParams.count;
    $('perlaw-n').textContent = perLawN.toLocaleString();
    const all128Row = D.perLaw.find(r => r.law === 'ALL_128');
    const zeroRow = D.perLaw.find(r => r.law === 'ZERO_LAWS');
    const all128Ms = all128Row ? all128Row.tickUs / 1000 : null;

    const lawRows = D.perLaw
      .filter(r => !isAnchorLaw(r.law))
      .sort((a, b) => (b.marginalUs ?? 0) - (a.marginalUs ?? 0));

    // Header summary chips.
    $('perlaw-summary').innerHTML =
      `<span class="chip"><b>ALL 128</b> — ${all128Row ? fmt(all128Ms) : '—'} ms/frame</span>` +
      `<span class="chip"><b>ZERO LAWS</b> — ${zeroRow ? fmt(zeroRow.tickUs / 1000) : '—'} ms/frame</span>`;

    // Bars: Δ Runtime sorted by marginal cost. Top 10 inline; the rest behind
    // a "View all" expander. A gold marker marks the MEDIAN marginal cost so
    // cheap vs expensive laws is readable at a glance.
    const maxMarg = Math.max(...lawRows.map(r => r.marginalUs ?? 0), 1);
    const medMarg = median(lawRows.map(r => r.marginalUs ?? 0));
    const medPct = (medMarg / maxMarg * 100).toFixed(2);
    const barRow = (r) => {
      const cat = D.categories[r.law];
      const catName = cat ? cat.category.toUpperCase() : '—';
      const color = CAT_COLORS[catName] || '#6b7280';
      const val = r.marginalUs ?? 0;
      const pct = (val / maxMarg * 100).toFixed(1);
      const soloMs = (r.soloUs ?? r.tickUs) / 1000;
      const withoutMs = r.withoutUs != null ? r.withoutUs / 1000 : (all128Ms != null ? all128Ms - val / 1000 : null);
      const tip = `<b>${r.law.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</b> · ${cat ? cat.category : '—'}<br>Solo: ${fmt(soloMs)} ms · Without: ${withoutMs != null ? fmt(withoutMs) + ' ms' : '—'}<br><span style="color:${color}">Δ runtime: +${fmt(val / 1000)} ms (${fmt(pct, 1)}%)</span>`;
      return `<div class="bar-row" data-tip="${tip.replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}">
        <div class="bar-label">${r.law.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</div>
        <div class="bar-track"><i class="bar-marker" style="left:${medPct}%"></i><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${pct}%;background:${color}"></div></div>
        <div class="bar-value">+${fmt(val / 1000)} ms (${fmt(pct, 1)}%)</div></div>`;
    };
    const TOP_N = 10;
    $('perlaw-bars').innerHTML = lawRows.slice(0, TOP_N).map(barRow).join('') +
      (lawRows.length > TOP_N
        ? `<details class="m-all"><summary>View all ${lawRows.length} laws</summary>${lawRows.slice(TOP_N).map(barRow).join('')}</details>`
        : '');

    // Ablation matrix (desktop): LAW | DOMAIN | SOLO | WITHOUT | Δ | Δ% | ETV/pair.
    const pt = $('perlaw-table');
    pt.innerHTML = '<thead><tr><th>Law</th><th>Domain</th><th>Solo Cost</th><th>Without Law</th><th>Δ Runtime</th><th>Δ %</th><th>ETV / Pair</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      lawRows.map(r => {
        const cat = D.categories[r.law];
        const catName = cat ? cat.category : '—';
        const color = CAT_COLORS[(catName || '').toUpperCase()] || '#6b7280';
        const soloMs = (r.soloUs ?? r.tickUs) / 1000;
        const withoutMs = r.withoutUs != null ? r.withoutUs / 1000 : (all128Ms != null ? all128Ms - (r.marginalUs ?? 0) / 1000 : null);
        const deltaMs = withoutMs != null && all128Ms != null ? all128Ms - withoutMs : null;
        const pctDelta = deltaMs != null ? (deltaMs / all128Ms) * 100 : null;
        const avgNeighbors = Math.min(500, perLawN);
        const etv = deltaMs > 0 ? fmt(deltaMs / (perLawN * avgNeighbors), 5) : '—';
        return `<tr><td><span class="law-cat" style="background:${color}"></span>${r.law.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</td>` +
          `<td style="color:${color}">${catName}</td>` +
          `<td>${fmt(soloMs)}</td>` +
          `<td>${withoutMs != null ? fmt(withoutMs) : '—'}</td>` +
          `<td>${deltaMs != null ? '+' + fmt(deltaMs) : '—'}</td>` +
          `<td>${pctDelta != null ? '+' + fmt(pctDelta, 2) + '%' : '—'}</td>` +
          `<td>${etv}</td></tr>`;
      }).join('') + '</tbody>';

    // Mobile per-law cards: top offenders as ranked list.
    $('perlaw-mobile').innerHTML = `<div class="m-card">
      <div class="m-title">Marginal cost ranking</div>
      <div class="m-dir">Δ runtime when removed from ALL 128 · ↓ cheapest is best</div>` +
      lawRows.slice(0, 12).map(r => {
        const cat = D.categories[r.law];
        const catName = cat ? cat.category.toUpperCase() : '—';
        const color = CAT_COLORS[catName] || '#6b7280';
        const val = r.marginalUs ?? 0;
        return `<div class="m-row"><span class="m-k" style="width:120px;font-size:10px;color:${color}">${r.law.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</span>
          <span class="m-bar"><i style="width:${(val / maxMarg * 100).toFixed(1)}%;background:${color}"></i></span>
          <span class="m-v">+${fmt(val / 1000)} ms</span></div>`;
      }).join('') + '</div>';

    // Category cards.
    const cats = {};
    for (const r of lawRows) {
      const cat = D.categories[r.law];
      const catName = cat ? cat.category.toUpperCase() : 'UNKNOWN';
      (cats[catName] = cats[catName] || []).push(r);
    }
    $('category-cards').innerHTML = Object.entries(cats)
      .sort((a, b) => b[1].reduce((s, l) => s + (l.marginalUs ?? 0), 0) - a[1].reduce((s, l) => s + (l.marginalUs ?? 0), 0))
      .map(([catName, laws]) => {
        const color = CAT_COLORS[catName] || '#6b7280';
        const total = laws.reduce((s, l) => s + (l.marginalUs ?? 0), 0);
        const sorted = [...laws].sort((a, b) => (b.marginalUs ?? 0) - (a.marginalUs ?? 0));
        return `<div class="card">
          <h3><span><span class="law-cat" style="background:${color}"></span>${catName.toLowerCase()}</span>
          <span style="color:${color};font-size:10.5px">Σ ${fmt(total / 1000)} ms</span></h3>` +
          sorted.map(r => `<div class="bar-row">
            <div class="bar-label" style="width:90px;font-size:9.5px">${r.law.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</div>
            <div class="bar-track" style="height:10px"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${total > 0 ? ((r.marginalUs ?? 0) / total * 100).toFixed(1) : 0}%;background:${color};opacity:.75"></div></div>
            <div class="bar-value" style="width:70px;font-size:9.5px">${fmt((r.marginalUs ?? 0) / 1000)} ms</div></div>`).join('') +
          '</div>';
      }).join('');
  }

  // ── Tuning-knob matrix (heat-encoded) ──────────────────────────
  if (D.matrix) {
    const mat = D.matrix;
    const cols = mat[0].cells.map(c => c.interactions);
    const flat = mat.flatMap(row => row.cells.map(c => c.msPerTick));
    const lo = Math.min(...flat), hi = Math.max(...flat);
    $('matrix').innerHTML = '<thead><tr><th>NBUF \\ MAXINT ↓ lower is better</th>' +
      cols.map(c => `<th>${c}</th>`).join('') + '</tr></thead><tbody>' +
      mat.map(row => `<tr><td>${row.neighbors}</td>` + row.cells.map(c => {
        const isBest = c.msPerTick === lo;
        return `<td class="${isBest ? 'best' : ''}" style="${heatStyle(c.msPerTick, lo, hi)}">${fmt(c.msPerTick)}</td>`;
      }).join('') + '</tr>').join('') + '</tbody>';
  }

  // ── Knob sweeps ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const SWEEPS = [
    { key: 'gridDim', title: 'GRID_DIM sweep', color: '#4fd1c5' },
    { key: 'cellCap', title: 'CELL_CAP sweep', color: '#f5a3b5' },
    { key: 'maxInteractions', title: 'MAX_INTERACTIONS sweep', color: '#f7c873' },
    { key: 'neighborBuf', title: 'NEIGHBOR_BUF sweep', color: '#9aa7ff' },
  ];
  $('sweeps').innerHTML = SWEEPS.map((s, idx) => D[s.key]
    ? `<div class="card"><h3>${s.title} <span class="dir">↑ fps is better</span></h3>
       <canvas id="sweep-${idx}" class="chart" width="480" height="170" style="border:0;background:none;margin:0"></canvas></div>`
    : '').join('');
  SWEEPS.forEach((s, idx) => {
    const cv = $('sweep-' + idx);
    if (cv && D[s.key]) {
      drawLine(cv, D[s.key].map(r => String(r.value)),
        [{ name: s.title.replace(' sweep', ''), values: D[s.key].map(r => r.msPerTick > 0 ? 1000 / r.msPerTick : 0), color: s.color }],
        { fps: true });
    }
  });

  // Shared tap/hover tooltip for any element carrying data-tip (bar rows).
  // Touch-friendly: tap to show, tap elsewhere or move off to hide.
  (function barTips() {
    const tipEl = document.createElement('div');
    tipEl.className = 'chart-tip';
    document.body.appendChild(tipEl);
    const show = (ev, row) => {
      tipEl.innerHTML = row.dataset.tip;
      tipEl.style.display = 'block';
      const pad = 12;
      let x = ev.clientX + pad, y = ev.clientY + pad;
      const r = tipEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (x + r.width > window.innerWidth - 8) x = ev.clientX - r.width - pad;
      if (y + r.height > window.innerHeight - 8) y = ev.clientY - r.height - pad;
      tipEl.style.left = x + 'px'; tipEl.style.top = y + 'px';
    };
    document.addEventListener('pointermove', (ev) => {
      const row = ev.target && ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest('[data-tip]') : null;
      if (!row) { tipEl.style.display = 'none'; return; }
      show(ev, row);
    });
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (ev) => {
      const row = ev.target && ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest('[data-tip]') : null;
      if (!row) { tipEl.style.display = 'none'; return; }
      show(ev, row);
    });
  })();

  // Anchor nav: expand the target accordion BEFORE scrolling (a collapsed
  // <details> otherwise makes the pill look dead). Also handles deep links
  // like bench-report/#sec-ablation.
  (function sectionNav() {
    const openByHash = (hash) => {
      if (!hash || hash.length < 2) return;
      let el = null;
      try { el = document.querySelector(hash); } catch (e) { return; }
      if (el && el.tagName === 'DETAILS') el.open = true;
    };
    document.querySelectorAll('#topnav a').forEach((a) => {
      a.addEventListener('click', () => openByHash(a.getAttribute('href')));
    });
    if (window.addEventListener) window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => openByHash(location.hash));
    openByHash(typeof location !== 'undefined' ? location.hash : '');
  })();

  } // end renderAll()

  // ── Initial render ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  renderAll();

  $('foot').innerHTML =
    `<span class="warn">Dataset auto-generated by bench/solver.bench.mjs.</span> ` +
    `baseline ${JSON.stringify(D.baseline)} · default laws [${D.solver.defaultLaws.join(', ')}] · exhaustive profile: ${D.solver.lawCount} laws.` +
    `<br><b>Solo Cost vs Without Law</b>: Solo Cost measures a full frame with only that law enabled — it includes the solver's fixed overhead (grid build, neighbour gather, integration). Without Law is a leave-one-out measurement against the full 128-law config; Δ Runtime = ALL 128 − Without Law. Because laws interact, Δ % rows intentionally do not sum to 100%.` +
    `<br><b>Main vs worker</b>: main values block the UI for the solver duration; worker values keep the UI thread available while reporting solver time, with cold worker-start/request round-trip overhead shown separately. All timings are milliseconds per frame; throughput is 1000 ÷ ms/frame. Hover or touch the performance chart for exact values at each scale.`;
</script>
</body>
</html>
````

````js
/*
 * Compatibility bridge for cached pre-Vite VEPA documents.
 * Older cached HTML points at /src/react-entry.js and /style.css. The current
 * build uses hashed assets under /assets/, so discover those assets from the
 * current root document and boot the current bundle from the legacy URL.
 */
(async () => {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`${location.origin}${location.pathname}`, {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: { Accept: 'text/html' },
    });
    const html = await response.text();
    const css = html.match(/href="(\/assets\/[^\"]+\.css)"/i)?.[1];
    const js = html.match(/src="([^"]*\/assets\/[^\"]+\.js)"/i)?.[1];

    if (css && !document.querySelector(`link[href="${css}"]`)) {
      const link = document.createElement('link');
      link.rel = 'stylesheet';
      link.href = css;
      document.head.appendChild(link);
    }
    if (!js) {
      // Dev server (or base-prefixed deploy): no hashed /assets/ bundle is
      // referenced by the served document. Boot the source runtime directly
      // so local development and e2e acceptance tests exercise real code.
      await import('/src/main.js');
      return;
    }
    await import(`${location.origin}${js}`);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('VEPA compatibility bridge failed:', error);
  }
})();

````

````js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// ACO-2 (AC-27): reproducible reconciliation of the historical a3 audit corpus
// against the live law manifests (LAW_INDEXES, LAW_CATEGORIES, solver files).
//
//   node scripts/a3-reconciliation.mjs           # write docs/audit/A3-RECONCILIATION.md
//   node scripts/a3-reconciliation.mjs --check   # fail if the committed report is stale
//
// Lists every a3 claim (progress ledger + stage-1 headers) that disagrees with
// the manifests: retired/renamed laws, index and category mismatches, missing
// solver targets, laws with no a3 coverage, and the corpus-level law count.
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';

const { LAW_INDEXES, LAW_COUNT, LAW_TO_CATEGORY, LAW_CATEGORIES } = await import('../src/constants.js');
const ROOT = 'docs/audit/laws/a3';
const OUT = 'docs/audit/A3-RECONCILIATION.md';
const NAME_BY_IDX = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(LAW_INDEXES).map(([n, i]) => [i, n]));

const ledger = readFileSync(`${ROOT}/audit_progress.md`, 'utf8');
const claims = [];
let cat = null;
for (const line of ledger.split('\n')) {
  const c = line.match(/^## Category: (\w+)/);
  if (c) { cat = c[1].toLowerCase(); continue; }
  const m = line.match(/^\| \*\*#(\d+) ([A-Z0-9_]+)\*\* \|(.*)\|\s*$/);
  if (m) claims.push({ source: 'audit_progress.md', index: +m[1], name: m[2], category: cat, complete: !/\[ \]/.test(m[3]) });
}
const totalClaim = (ledger.match(/\*\*Total Laws\*\*: (\d+)/) || [])[1];

const stage1 = [];
for (const f of readdirSync(`${ROOT}/stage-1`).sort()) {
  const s = readFileSync(`${ROOT}/stage-1/${f}`, 'utf8');
  const head = s.match(/Law #(\d+) — ([A-Z0-9_]+)/);
  const category = (s.match(/\*\*Category\*\*: (\w+)/) || [])[1];
  const target = (s.match(/\*\*Solver Target\*\*: `([^`]+)`/) || [])[1];
  if (head) stage1.push({ source: `stage-1/${f}`, index: +head[1], name: head[2], category: category && category.toLowerCase(), target });
}

const rows = [];
const add = (kind, law, claim, manifest, source) => rows.push({ kind, law, claim, manifest, source });
for (const c of [...claims, ...stage1]) {
  const live = LAW_INDEXES[c.name];
  if (live === undefined) {
    add('retired or renamed', c.name, `#${c.index} ${c.name}${c.complete ? ' (claimed complete)' : ''}`, NAME_BY_IDX[c.index] ? `index ${c.index} is now ${NAME_BY_IDX[c.index]}` : `index ${c.index} unused`, c.source);
    continue;
  }
  if (live !== c.index) add('index mismatch', c.name, `#${c.index}`, `#${live}`, c.source);
  const liveCat = LAW_TO_CATEGORY[live];
  if (c.category && liveCat && c.category !== liveCat) add('category mismatch', c.name, c.category, liveCat, c.source);
  if (c.target && !existsSync(c.target)) add('missing solver target', c.name, c.target, 'file not in tree', c.source);
}
const covered = new Set([...claims, ...stage1].map((c) => c.name));
for (const [name, idx] of Object.entries(LAW_INDEXES).sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1])) {
  if (!covered.has(name)) add('no a3 coverage', name, '—', `#${idx} ${LAW_TO_CATEGORY[idx] || '?'}`, 'manifest');
}
if (totalClaim && +totalClaim !== LAW_COUNT) add('law count', '(corpus)', `${totalClaim} laws, ${claims.length ? new Set(claims.map((c) => c.category)).size : '?'} categories`, `${LAW_COUNT} laws, ${Object.keys(LAW_CATEGORIES).length} categories`, 'audit_progress.md');

const kinds = [...new Set(rows.map((r) => r.kind))];
let md = `# a3 audit corpus reconciliation (ACO-2)\n\nGenerated by \`node scripts/a3-reconciliation.mjs\` from \`${ROOT}\` (historical, D-009) and the live manifests\n(\`src/constants.js\`: LAW_INDEXES, LAW_CATEGORIES). Do not edit by hand; \`--check\` fails when stale.\n\n`;
md += `Ledger rows: ${claims.length}. Stage-1 reports: ${stage1.length}. Live laws: ${LAW_COUNT}. Disagreements: ${rows.length}.\n\n`;
md += '| Kind | Count |\n|---|---:|\n' + kinds.map((k) => `| ${k} | ${rows.filter((r) => r.kind === k).length} |`).join('\n') + '\n\n';
md += '| Kind | Law | a3 claim | Manifest | Source |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n';
md += rows.map((r) => `| ${r.kind} | ${r.law} | ${r.claim} | ${r.manifest} | ${r.source} |`).join('\n') + '\n';

if (process.argv.includes('--check')) {
  const cur = existsSync(OUT) ? readFileSync(OUT, 'utf8') : '';
  if (cur !== md) { console.error(`${OUT} is stale; run node scripts/a3-reconciliation.mjs`); process.exit(1); }
  console.log(`a3 reconciliation up to date (${rows.length} disagreements).`);
} else {
  writeFileSync(OUT, md);
  console.log(`wrote ${OUT}: ${rows.length} disagreements`);
}

````

### Source

````js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Read-only audit-corpus inventory. It never edits, deletes, or relocates files.

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, relative } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const ROOT = join(fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url)));
const CORPUS = join(ROOT, 'docs', 'audit', 'laws', 'a3');

function walk(dir) {
  const files = [];
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))) {
    const path = join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) files.push(...walk(path));
    else if (entry.isFile() && entry.name.endsWith('.md')) files.push(path);
  }
  return files;
}

function hashFile(path) {
  return createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(path)).digest('hex');
}

export function inspectAuditCorpus(root = CORPUS) {
  const files = walk(root);
  const hashes = new Map();
  const groups = new Map();
  let bytes = 0;
  const families = {};

  for (const file of files) {
    const rel = relative(ROOT, file).split('\\').join('/');
    const hash = hashFile(file);
    const size = statSync(file).size;
    bytes += size;
    if (!groups.has(hash)) groups.set(hash, []);
    groups.get(hash).push(rel);
    const family = rel.includes('/stage-1/') ? 'stage-1'
      : rel.includes('/stage-2/') ? 'stage-2'
        : rel.includes('/stage-3/') ? 'stage-3'
          : 'rollups';
    families[family] = (families[family] || 0) + 1;
    hashes.set(rel, { sha256: hash, bytes: size, family });
  }

  const exactDuplicateGroups = [...groups.values()].filter(group => group.length > 1);
  return {
    corpusRoot: relative(ROOT, root).split('\\').join('/'),
    generatedAt: 'runtime',
    fileCount: files.length,
    bytes,
    families,
    exactDuplicateGroupCount: exactDuplicateGroups.length,
    exactDuplicateFileCount: exactDuplicateGroups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.length, 0),
    exactDuplicateGroups,
    files: [...hashes.entries()].map(([path, info]) => ({ path, ...info })),
    ownership: {
      stageReports: 'historical audit evidence; retain until producer and review scope are confirmed',
      rollups: 'derived summaries; compare against stage reports before any consolidation',
      deletionPolicy: 'no deletion or relocation authorized by this report',
    },
  };
}

if (import.meta.url === `file://${process.argv[1]}`) {
  const report = inspectAuditCorpus();
  if (process.argv.includes('--json')) console.log(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
  else {
    console.log(`Audit corpus: ${report.corpusRoot}`);
    console.log(`Files: ${report.fileCount}; bytes: ${report.bytes}`);
    console.log(`Families: ${JSON.stringify(report.families)}`);
    console.log(`Exact duplicate groups: ${report.exactDuplicateGroupCount}`);
    console.log('No files were modified.');
  }
}

````

````js
#!/usr/bin/env node
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';

const plan = JSON.parse(await readFile(new URL('../exports/publication-plan.json', import.meta.url), 'utf8'));
const errors = [];
if (plan.status !== 'configured-not-published') errors.push('publication status must remain explicit');
if (!plan.repository || !plan.sourceRepository) errors.push('source and destination repositories are required');
if (!Array.isArray(plan.canonicalArtifacts) || plan.canonicalArtifacts.length < 2) errors.push('at least two canonical handoff artifacts are required');
for (const artifact of plan.canonicalArtifacts || []) {
  if (!artifact.path || !artifact.producer || !artifact.useCase) errors.push(`incomplete artifact record: ${artifact.path || '<unnamed>'}`);
}
if (!plan.publication?.requiredEnvironment?.includes('VEPA_EXPORTS_TOKEN')) errors.push('publication must require an explicit token');
if (errors.length) {
  console.error(errors.join('\n'));
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log(`export publication contract valid: ${plan.repository} (${plan.status})`);
````

````js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Validate repository contracts without modifying the worktree.
import { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { LAW_INDEXES } from '../src/constants.js';
import { validateLawOntology, LAW_RELATIONSHIPS } from '../src/state/lawOntology.js';
import { validateLawGraph } from '../src/physics/lawGraph.js';
import { validateProvenance } from './validate-provenance.mjs';
import { validateSignoffFile } from './validate-signoff.mjs';

const errors = [];
const readJson = (path) => JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, 'utf8'));
const packageJson = readJson('package.json');
const lockJson = readJson('package-lock.json');
const specManifest = readJson('docs/spec/manifest.json');
const implementationManifest = readJson('docs/spec/laws/implementation-status.json');
const ontologyCoverage = readJson('docs/spec/laws/ontology-coverage.json');
const version = readFileSync('VERSION', 'utf8').trim();
const changelogTop = readFileSync('CHANGELOG.md', 'utf8').match(/^## .*→\s*([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)/m)?.[1];

function requireEqual(label, actual, expected) {
  if (actual !== expected) errors.push(`${label}: expected ${expected}, got ${actual}`);
}

requireEqual('VERSION/package.json', version, packageJson.version);
requireEqual('VERSION/package-lock.json', version, lockJson.version);
requireEqual('VERSION/changelog', version, changelogTop);
requireEqual('spec manifest version', specManifest.version, version);
requireEqual('spec manifest package', specManifest.project, packageJson.name);
requireEqual('law manifest declared count', implementationManifest.declaredLawCount, Object.keys(LAW_INDEXES).length);
requireEqual('ontology coverage declared count', ontologyCoverage.declaredLawCount, Object.keys(LAW_INDEXES).length);

const expectedIndexes = Array.from({ length: Object.keys(LAW_INDEXES).length }, (_, index) => index);
const actualIndexes = implementationManifest.records.map(record => record.index);
if (JSON.stringify(actualIndexes) !== JSON.stringify(expectedIndexes)) {
  errors.push('law implementation manifest indexes are not continuous and ordered');
}

const ontologyErrors = [...validateLawOntology(), ...validateLawGraph()];
for (const error of validateProvenance()) errors.push(`provenance: ${error}`);
for (const error of validateSignoffFile()) errors.push(`signoff: ${error}`);
for (const error of new Set(ontologyErrors)) errors.push(`ontology: ${error}`);

const declaredNames = new Set(Object.keys(LAW_INDEXES));
const coveredNames = new Set([
  ...ontologyCoverage.lawsWithMetadata,
  ...ontologyCoverage.lawsWithoutMetadata,
]);
if (coveredNames.size !== declaredNames.size || [...declaredNames].some(name => !coveredNames.has(name))) {
  errors.push('ontology coverage does not account for every registered law');
}
if ([...coveredNames].some(name => !declaredNames.has(name))) {
  errors.push('ontology coverage contains an unknown law');
}
if (!existsSync('docs/spec/README.md') || !existsSync('docs/spec/procedure.md')) {
  errors.push('generated specification README/procedure is missing');
}

if (errors.length > 0) {
  console.error('repository:check failed');
  for (const error of errors) console.error(`- ${error}`);
  process.exitCode = 1;
} else {
  console.log(`repository:check passed (${declaredNames.size} laws, version ${version}, ${Object.keys(LAW_RELATIONSHIPS).length} ontology records, provenance manifests valid, signoff manifest valid).`);
}

````
