### Source

````js
// ============================================================================
// VEPA v3 — Physics Worker
// Web Worker that runs the physics simulation off the main thread.
// Handles INIT, CONFIG, TOGGLE_LAW, and TICK messages.
// Falls back to main-thread tick loop if SharedArrayBuffer is unavailable.
// ============================================================================

import { solve, buildNeighborPairs, drainOffspring, resetOffspringRing } from '../physics/solver.js';
import {
  createLawState,
  toggle as toggleLaw,
  set as setLaw,
  clear as clearLaw,
  isSet,
  serialize as serializeLawState,
  deserialize as deserializeLawState,
} from '../state/lawState.js';
import {
  PARTICLE_STRIDE,
  MAX_PARTICLES,
  WORLD_SIZE,
  LAW_COUNT,
  LAW_INDEXES,
} from '../constants.js';
import { runtimeConfig } from '../state/runtimeConfig.js';
import { createGPUContext, gpuComputeForces } from '../physics/gpuCompute.js';

const hasSAB = typeof SharedArrayBuffer !== 'undefined';
const isShared = (value) => hasSAB && value instanceof SharedArrayBuffer;

// ── Worker State ──

let particleBuffer = null;   // SharedArrayBuffer (or fallback ArrayBuffer)
let particleView = null;     // Float32Array view over particleBuffer
let particleCount = 0;
let stride = PARTICLE_STRIDE;
let worldSize = WORLD_SIZE;
let lawState = createLawState();
let dnaBuffer = null;        // SharedArrayBuffer for species DNA
let dnaView = null;          // Uint16Array view over dnaBuffer
let dt = 1.0; // worker time step
let tickCount = 0;
let hasSharedArrayBuffer = hasSAB;
let gpuContext = null;
let gpuReady = false;
let tickInFlight = false;

// ── Fallback State (no SharedArrayBuffer) ──

let fallbackBuffer = null;
let fallbackView = null;
let fallbackActive = false;

// ── Message Handler ──

self.onmessage = function onWorkerMessage(event) {
  const msg = event.data;
  if (!msg || !msg.type) return;

  switch (msg.type) {
    case 'INIT':
      Promise.resolve(handleInit(msg)).catch((error) => {
        self.postMessage({ type: 'ERROR', error: `INIT: ${error.message || error}` });
      });
      break;

    case 'CONFIG':
      handleConfig(msg);
      break;

    case 'TOGGLE_LAW':
      handleToggleLaw(msg);
      break;

    case 'TICK':
      // Keep the worker single-flight: the main thread may render freely, but
      // physics ticks are serialized so completion order remains deterministic.
      if (tickInFlight) {
        self.postMessage({ type: 'TICK_QUEUED', tickCount });
      } else {
        tickInFlight = true;
        Promise.resolve(handleTick(msg)).catch((error) => {
          self.postMessage({ type: 'ERROR', error: `TICK: ${error.message || error}` });
        }).finally(() => { tickInFlight = false; });
      }
      break;

    case 'GET_STATE':
      handleGetState();
      break;

    case 'RESTORE':
      handleRestore(msg);
      break;

    case 'PING':
      self.postMessage({ type: 'PONG', tickCount });
      break;

    default:
      self.postMessage({
        type: 'ERROR',
        error: `Unknown message type: ${msg.type}`,
      });
  }
};

// ── INIT Handler ──

async function handleInit(msg) {
  const {
    buffer: sharedBuffer,
    count,
    config,
    dnaBuffer: sharedDna,
  } = msg;

  // Determine if we have SharedArrayBuffer
  if (isShared(sharedBuffer)) {
    hasSharedArrayBuffer = true;
    particleBuffer = sharedBuffer;
    particleView = new Float32Array(particleBuffer);
  } else if (sharedBuffer instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
    // Fallback: main thread passed a regular ArrayBuffer (copy-on-write)
    hasSharedArrayBuffer = false;
    fallbackActive = true;
    fallbackBuffer = sharedBuffer;
    fallbackView = new Float32Array(fallbackBuffer);
    particleView = fallbackView;
  } else {
    self.postMessage({
      type: 'ERROR',
      error: 'INIT: Invalid buffer type. Expected SharedArrayBuffer or ArrayBuffer.',
    });
    return;
  }

  particleCount = count || 0;
  stride = PARTICLE_STRIDE;
  resetOffspringRing();
  tickCount = 0;

  // Apply initial config
  if (config) {
    applyConfig(config);
  }
  // Probe once, off the message handler's synchronous path. Unsupported
  // browsers cleanly report false and continue on the CPU solver.
  if (runtimeConfig.computeEngine === 'gpu') {
    gpuContext = await createGPUContext();
    gpuReady = !!gpuContext;
    if (gpuContext?.lost) {
      gpuContext.lost.then((status) => {
        if (!gpuReady) return;
        gpuReady = false;
        gpuContext = null;
        self.postMessage({ type: 'GPU_FALLBACK', reason: status.reason, error: status.message });
      }).catch((error) => {
        gpuReady = false;
        gpuContext = null;
        self.postMessage({ type: 'GPU_FALLBACK', reason: 'device-loss-monitor', error: error.message || String(error) });
      });
    }
  }

  // DNA buffer
  if (isShared(sharedDna)) {
    dnaBuffer = sharedDna;
    dnaView = new Uint16Array(dnaBuffer);
  } else if (sharedDna instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
    dnaBuffer = sharedDna;
    dnaView = new Uint16Array(dnaBuffer);
  } else {
    // Create default empty DNA buffer
    const dnaByteLength = 64 * 64 * Uint16Array.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT;
    if (hasSAB) {
      dnaBuffer = new SharedArrayBuffer(dnaByteLength);
    } else {
      dnaBuffer = new ArrayBuffer(dnaByteLength);
    }
    dnaView = new Uint16Array(dnaBuffer);
  }

  self.postMessage({
    type: 'INIT_COMPLETE',
    tickCount: 0,
    hasSharedArrayBuffer,
    particleCount,
    lawState: serializeLawState(lawState),      gpuAvailable: gpuReady,
    gpuActive: false,
  });
}

// ── CONFIG Handler ──

function handleConfig(msg) {
  const { config } = msg;
  if (config) {
    applyConfig(config);
  }

  // If new buffer provided, swap it in
  if (msg.buffer) {
    if (isShared(msg.buffer)) {
      particleBuffer = msg.buffer;
      particleView = new Float32Array(particleBuffer);
      hasSharedArrayBuffer = true;
    } else if (msg.buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
      fallbackBuffer = msg.buffer;
      fallbackView = new Float32Array(fallbackBuffer);
      particleView = fallbackView;
    }
  }

  // If new DNA buffer provided
  if (msg.dnaBuffer) {
    if (isShared(msg.dnaBuffer) || msg.dnaBuffer instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
      dnaBuffer = msg.dnaBuffer;
      dnaView = new Uint16Array(dnaBuffer);
    }
  }

  self.postMessage({
    type: 'CONFIG_COMPLETE',
    particleCount,
    worldSize,
    lawState: serializeLawState(lawState),
  });
}

function applyConfig(config) {
  if (config.particleCount !== undefined) particleCount = config.particleCount;
  if (config.worldSize !== undefined) worldSize = config.worldSize;
  if (config.dt !== undefined) dt = config.dt;
  if (config.seed !== undefined && tickCount === 0) _prngState = config.seed | 0;
  if (config.stride !== undefined) stride = config.stride;
  if (config.worldParams) runtimeConfig.worldParams = config.worldParams;
  if (config.computeEngine === 'gpu' || config.computeEngine === 'cpu') {
    runtimeConfig.computeEngine = config.computeEngine;
  }

  // Restore law state from serialized form
  if (config.lawState) {
    if (typeof config.lawState === 'object' && 'low' in config.lawState) {
      lawState = deserializeLawState(config.lawState);
    }
  }

  // Set specific laws from array
  if (config.laws && Array.isArray(config.laws)) {
    lawState = createLawState();
    for (let i = 0; i < config.laws.length && i < LAW_COUNT; i++) {
      if (config.laws[i]) {
        setLaw(lawState, i);
      }
    }
  }
}

// ── TOGGLE_LAW Handler ──

function handleToggleLaw(msg) {
  const { lawIndex, forceOn, forceOff } = msg;

  if (typeof lawIndex !== 'number' || lawIndex < 0 || lawIndex >= LAW_COUNT) {
    self.postMessage({
      type: 'ERROR',
      error: `TOGGLE_LAW: Invalid law index ${lawIndex}. Must be 0-${LAW_COUNT - 1}.`,
    });
    return;
  }

  if (forceOn) {
    setLaw(lawState, lawIndex);
  } else if (forceOff) {
    clearLaw(lawState, lawIndex);
  } else {
    toggleLaw(lawState, lawIndex);
  }

  self.postMessage({
    type: 'LAW_TOGGLED',
    lawIndex,
    active: isSet(lawState, lawIndex),
    lawState: serializeLawState(lawState),
  });
}

// ── TICK Handler ──

async function handleTick(msg) {
  if (!particleView) {
    self.postMessage({
      type: 'ERROR',
      error: 'TICK: No particle buffer initialized. Send INIT first.',
    });
    return;
  }

  if (msg.particleCount !== undefined) particleCount = msg.particleCount;
  if (msg.dt !== undefined) dt = msg.dt;

  const tickStart = performance.now();

  // WebGPU owns only the embarrassingly-parallel pairwise gravity
  // pre-pass. The CPU solver remains authoritative for every other law and
  // receives the GPU result explicitly, so GPU selection cannot silently
  // bypass DNA, lifecycle, field, chemistry, information, quantum, or
  // mechanics semantics.
  let gpuForces = null;
  if (gpuReady && runtimeConfig.computeEngine === 'gpu') {
    try {
      const pairs = buildNeighborPairs(particleView, particleCount, stride, worldSize);
      gpuForces = await gpuComputeForces(gpuContext, particleView, particleCount, pairs, {
        worldSize,
        G: 0.2 * (worldSize / 240) ** 2 * (Number(runtimeConfig.worldParams?.GLOBAL_G) || 1),
        softening: 0.5,
        maxForce: runtimeConfig.maxForce || 50,
        gravityEnabled: isSet(lawState, LAW_INDEXES.GRAV),
        // Keep CONTACT/COLL on the CPU: the exact solver owns positional
        // correction and velocity impulse semantics; the GPU contributes
        // gravity only to avoid double-applying collision response.
        collisionEnabled: false,
      });
      if (!gpuForces) {
        gpuReady = false;
        gpuContext = null;
        self.postMessage({ type: 'GPU_FALLBACK', reason: 'compute-failed', error: 'WebGPU compute returned no force buffer' });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      gpuReady = false;
      gpuContext = null;
      self.postMessage({ type: 'GPU_FALLBACK', error: error.message || String(error) });
    }
  }

  // Run the reference CPU solver, optionally consuming the completed GPU force
  // pre-pass. A null result is the normal CPU fallback.
  solve(
    particleView,
    particleCount,
    stride,
    lawState,
    dnaView,
    worldSize,
    dt,
    prng,
    gpuForces
  );

  // Collect offspring
  const offspring = drainOffspring();

  tickCount++;
  const tickDuration = performance.now() - tickStart;

  // Post result back to main thread
  const reply = {
    type: 'TICK_COMPLETE',
    tickCount,
    tickDuration,
    particleCount,
    gpuAvailable: gpuReady,
    gpuActive: !!gpuForces,
  };

  if (offspring.length > 0) {
    reply.offspring = offspring;
  }

  self.postMessage(reply);
}

// ── GET_STATE Handler ──

function handleGetState() {
  self.postMessage({
    type: 'STATE',
    particleCount,
    worldSize,
    tickCount,
    lawState: serializeLawState(lawState),
    hasSharedArrayBuffer,
    gpuAvailable: gpuReady,
  });
}

// ── RESTORE Handler ──

function handleRestore(msg) {
  if (msg.lawState) {
    lawState = deserializeLawState(msg.lawState);
  }
  if (msg.particleCount !== undefined) {
    particleCount = msg.particleCount;
  }
  if (msg.tickCount !== undefined) {
    tickCount = msg.tickCount;
  }

  self.postMessage({
    type: 'RESTORE_COMPLETE',
    tickCount,
    lawState: serializeLawState(lawState),
  });
}

// ── PRNG for Worker ──

// SplitMix32-style PRNG (deterministic, fast, no Math.random dependency)
let _prngState = 0x51f15e;

function prng() {
  let z = (_prngState + 0x9e3779b9) | 0;
  _prngState = z;
  z = (z ^ (z >>> 16)) | 0;
  z = Math.imul(z, 0x21f0aaad);
  z = z ^ (z >>> 15);
  z = Math.imul(z, 0x735a2d97);
  z = z ^ (z >>> 15);
  return (z >>> 0) / 4294967296;
}

// ── Main-Thread Fallback Mode ──

// When SharedArrayBuffer is unavailable, the worker runs in a simple
// request/response loop: main thread sends buffer copies, worker
// processes them and sends them back. This is slower but functional.
//
// The TICK handler above already works for both modes:
// - SharedArrayBuffer: solver writes directly, main thread sees changes
// - ArrayBuffer: worker sends TICK_COMPLETE, main thread must copy state back
//
// The main thread should check hasSharedArrayBuffer in INIT_COMPLETE
// and decide whether to re-copy the buffer after each TICK_COMPLETE.

self.postMessage({ type: 'WORKER_READY' });
````

````css
  color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 95%) 74%);
  border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 85%) 58%);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 85%) 60% / 0.35);
}

/* DNA Slider */
.dna-slider-group {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.dna-slider-group label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    min-width: 100px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}
.dna-slider-group input[type="range"] {
    flex: 1;
    height: 4px;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    background: var(--bg-tertiary);
    border-radius: 2px;
    outline: none;
}
.dna-slider-group input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent-blue);
    cursor: pointer;
}
.dna-slider-group .dna-value {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    color: var(--accent-gold);
    min-width: 36px;
    text-align: right;
}

/* Species Selector */
.species-selector {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.species-btn {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid var(--border);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
}
.species-btn.active { border-color: var(--accent-gold); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.4); }
.species-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.1); }

/* Narrative Log */
#narrative-panel {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.6;
    max-height: 300px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}
.narrative-entry {
    padding: 4px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.narrative-voice {
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-right: 6px;
}
.narrative-voice.stabilizer { color: var(--accent-blue); }
.narrative-voice.diverger { color: var(--accent-red); }
.narrative-voice.observer { color: var(--accent-green); }
.narrative-voice.dissolver { color: var(--accent-purple); }

/* Scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border); border-radius: 2px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); }

/* ── Panel Sections ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.panel-section {
    margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.panel-section h3 {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

/* ── Law Panel ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.law-category-header {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.law-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.law-btn {
    padding: 4px 6px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    background: var(--bg-tertiary);
    color: var(--text-dim);
    font-size: 9px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    cursor: pointer;
    text-align: center;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}
.law-btn:hover { border-color: var(--text-secondary); color: var(--text-primary); }
.law-btn.active { font-weight: 700; }

.law-state-indicator {
    font-size: 8px;
    opacity: 0.7;
}

/* ── DNA Panel ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.dna-section-title {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.dna-slider-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.dna-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    min-width: 100px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.dna-input {
    flex: 1;
    height: 4px;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    background: var(--bg-tertiary);
    border-radius: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.dna-input::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent-blue);
    cursor: pointer;
}
.dna-input::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent-blue);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}

.dna-value {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    color: var(--accent-gold);
    min-width: 36px;
    text-align: right;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ── Species Selector ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.species-selector {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    padding: 4px 0;
}

.species-dot {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid var(--border);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}
.species-dot.active { border-color: var(--accent-gold); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.4); }
.species-dot:hover { transform: scale(1.1); }

/* ── Preset Panel ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.preset-title {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.preset-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    align-items: center;
}

.preset-input {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    background: var(--bg-tertiary);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
}
.preset-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent-blue); }

.preset-select {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    background: var(--bg-tertiary);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    cursor: pointer;
}
.preset-select option {
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    color: var(--text-primary);
}

.preset-btn {
    padding: 4px 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    background: var(--bg-tertiary);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font-size: 11px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.preset-btn:hover { background: rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.15); border-color: var(--accent-blue); }
.preset-btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(255, 74, 74, 0.15); border-color: var(--accent-red); }

/* ── Narrative Panel ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#narrative-panel {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.6;
    max-height: 300px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}
.narrative-entry {
    padding: 4px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.narrative-voice {
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-right: 6px;
}
.narrative-voice.stabilizer { color: var(--accent-blue); }
.narrative-voice.diverger { color: var(--accent-red); }
.narrative-voice.observer { color: var(--accent-green); }
.narrative-voice.dissolver { color: var(--accent-purple); }

/* ── HUD ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.hud {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    margin-left: 8px;
    padding-left: 8px;
    border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.hud span { white-space: nowrap; }

/* ============================================================
   VEPA v3 — Layout & Component Styles (v2 parity layout)
   Added 2026-07-29
   ============================================================ */

/* ── Top Toolbar ── */
#top-toolbar {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 36px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    background: var(--bg-panel);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    z-index: 10;
    padding: 0 8px;
    gap: 4px;
}
.toolbar-left, .toolbar-right {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2px;
    align-items: center;
}
.toolbar-center {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: center;
}
.hud-population-orb {
    --population-h: 190;
    --population-intensity: 1;
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    width: auto;
    min-width: 24px;
    height: 14px;
    color: hsl(var(--population-h) 90% 72% / var(--population-intensity));
}
.hud-population-orb::before {
    content: '';
    width: 7px;
    height: 7px;
    flex: 0 0 7px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: hsl(var(--population-h) 95% 65% / var(--population-intensity));
    box-shadow: 0 0 5px hsl(var(--population-h) 95% 65% / var(--population-intensity));
}
.hud-population-orb::after {
    content: attr(data-count);
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 0.25px;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.hud-item {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    letter-spacing: 1px;
}
#top-toolbar .sq-btn {
    width: 28px;
    height: 24px;
    font-size: 11px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
#top-toolbar .sq-btn:hover {
    border-color: var(--accent-blue);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    background: rgba(74,158,255,0.1);
}
#top-toolbar .sq-btn.active {
    border-color: var(--accent-orange);
    color: var(--accent-orange);
}
#chaos-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent-red); color: var(--accent-red); }

/* ── Drawer resize handle (top edge) ── */
#drawer-resize-handle {
  flex: 0 0 8px;
  height: 8px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  cursor: row-resize;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
  touch-action: none;
  transition: background 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
#drawer-resize-handle::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 44px;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
  transition: background 0.15s ease;
}
#drawer-resize-handle:hover,
#drawer-resize-handle.dragging {
  background: rgba(74,158,255,0.14);
  box-shadow: 0 -1px 10px rgba(74,158,255,0.3);
}
#drawer-resize-handle:hover::after,
#drawer-resize-handle.dragging::after {
  background: var(--accent-blue);
}

/* ── Drawer zoom buttons ── */
#main-panel .drawer-zoom-btn {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--text-dim);
}
#main-panel .drawer-zoom-btn:hover { color: var(--accent-blue); background: rgba(74,158,255,0.08); }

/* ── Bottom Drawer ── */
#drawer-container {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    max-height: 50vh;
    background: var(--bg-panel);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    z-index: 10;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
}
#main-panel {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── Tab Navigation ── */
#main-panel .tabs {
    display: flex;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    touch-action: none;
}
#main-panel .tab-btn {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 8px 4px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}
#main-panel .tab-btn:hover { color: var(--text-secondary); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }
#main-panel .tab-btn.active { color: var(--accent-red); border-bottom-color: var(--accent-red); }
#main-panel .drawer-minimize-btn {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    color: var(--text-dim);
}
#main-panel .drawer-minimize-btn:hover { color: var(--accent-red); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); }
#main-panel .drawer-hide-btn {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    color: var(--text-dim);
}
#main-panel .drawer-hide-btn:hover { color: var(--accent-red); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); }

/* ── Hidden Drawer (slides below the viewport) ── */
#drawer-container.hidden {
    transform: translateY(105%);
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: transform 0.28s ease, visibility 0s linear 0.28s;
}
#drawer-container {
    will-change: transform;
    transition: transform 0.28s ease, visibility 0s linear;
}
#drawer-container::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent-red), transparent);
    opacity: 0.65;
    z-index: 1;
    pointer-events: none;
}

/* Floating show button (reopens the hidden drawer) */
#drawer-show-btn {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 11;
    padding: 6px 18px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    background: var(--bg-panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-bottom: none;
    border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}
#drawer-show-btn:hover { color: var(--accent-red); border-color: var(--accent-red); }

/* ── Tab Content Panels ── */
#main-panel .tab-content {
    display: none;
    overflow-y: auto;
    flex: 1;
    padding: 4px 0;
}
#main-panel .tab-content.active { display: block; }

/* ── Sub-tabs (DATA > INTELLIGENCE|DNA|LOGS, CONFIG > WORLD|SPECIES|SETTINGS) ── */
#main-panel .sub-tabs {
    display: flex;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 0 8px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
#main-panel .sub-tab-btn {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 6px 4px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    cursor: pointer;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
#main-panel .sub-tab-btn:hover { color: var(--text-secondary); }
#main-panel .sub-tab-btn.active { color: var(--accent-blue); border-bottom-color: var(--accent-blue); }
#main-panel .sub-tab-content { display: none; padding: 4px 0; }
#main-panel .sub-tab-content.active { display: block; }


/* ── Minimized Drawer ── */
#drawer-container.minimized {
    max-height: none;
}
#drawer-container.minimized .tab-content {
    display: none !important;
}
#drawer-container.minimized #main-panel .tabs {
    border-bottom: none;
}

/* ── Category Filter (World tab) ── */
.category-filter-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 3px;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.cat-tab {
    padding: 3px 10px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    color: var(--text-dim);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.cat-tab:hover { border-color: var(--text-secondary); color: var(--text-secondary); }
/* Category filter buttons carry their own spectrum colour (dull off, bright on) */
.cat-tab { color: hsl(var(--cat-h, 210) 80% 72% / 0.7); border-color: hsl(var(--cat-h, 210) 70% 55% / 0.35); }
.cat-tab.active { border-color: hsl(var(--cat-h, 210) 95% 64%); color: hsl(var(--cat-h, 210) 95% 72%); background: hsl(var(--cat-h, 210) 85% 55% / 0.12); }

/* ── Law Icon Grid (World tab) ── */
#law-grid.hidden { display: none !important; }

.law-icon-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(32px, 1fr));
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 6px;
}
.law-icon-grid .sq-toggle {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    background: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 10px;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
    min-height: 28px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
}
/* Category colour visible even when the law is off (bright when active) */
.law-icon-grid .sq-toggle { color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 80%) 72% / 0.55); border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 65%) 50% / 0.30); background: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 70%) 50% / 0.05); }
.law-icon-grid .sq-toggle.active { border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 95%) 62%); background: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 85%) 55% / 0.15); box-shadow: 0 0 6px hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 85%) 60% / 0.25); color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 95%) 85%); }

/* ── World Sliders ── */
.world-sliders {
    padding: 4px 8px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.world-slider-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 3px 0;
}
.world-slider-row label {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    min-width: 80px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.world-slider-row input[type="range"] {
    flex: 1;
    height: 3px;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    background: var(--border);
    border-radius: 2px;
    outline: none;
}
.world-slider-row input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent-red);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}
.world-slider-row .slider-value {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    color: var(--accent-red);
    min-width: 30px;
    text-align: right;
}

/* ── Species Tab ── */
.species-controls-header {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    align-items: center;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
#add-species-btn {
    padding: 3px 10px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--accent-green);
    color: var(--accent-green);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    cursor: pointer;
}
#add-species-btn:hover { background: rgba(74,255,138,0.1); }
#remove-species-btn {
    padding: 3px 10px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--accent-red);
    color: var(--accent-red);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    cursor: pointer;
}
#remove-species-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,80,80,0.1); }
.species-remove {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    line-height: 1;
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    font-size: 9px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
}
.species-remove:hover { color: var(--accent-red); border-color: var(--accent-red); }
.species-remove.disabled { opacity: 0.25; pointer-events: none; }

#species-list { padding: 4px; }
.species-card {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s;
}
.species-card:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }
.species-card.selected { background: rgba(74,158,255,0.08); border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-blue); }
.species-swatch { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--border); flex-shrink: 0; }
.species-name { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-primary); letter-spacing: 1px; flex: 1; }
.species-count { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 8px; color: var(--text-dim); }

/* ── Accordion ── */
.main-accordion { padding: 4px; }
.accordion-section {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    margin-bottom: 3px;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.accordion-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    transition: all 0.15s;
}
.accordion-header:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color: var(--text-primary); }
.accordion-header .arrow { transition: transform 0.2s; font-size: 7px; }
.accordion-section.open .accordion-header .arrow { transform: rotate(90deg); }
.accordion-section.open .accordion-header { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.accordion-body { display: none; padding: 4px 8px; }
.accordion-section.open .accordion-body { display: block; }

/* ── Sub-group accordions (grouped world params) ── */
.sub-accordion-section {
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border-radius: 3px;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.sub-accordion-section.open .sub-accordion-body { display: block; }
.sub-accordion-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 4px 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 7px;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    color: var(--accent-gold);
    opacity: 0.75;
    transition: all 0.15s;
}
.sub-accordion-header:hover { opacity: 1; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }
.sub-accordion-header .arrow { transition: transform 0.2s; font-size: 7px; }
.sub-accordion-section.open .sub-accordion-header .arrow { transform: rotate(90deg); }
.sub-accordion-body { display: none; padding: 2px 4px 4px; }
.accordion-slider-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 2px 0;
}
.accordion-slider-row label {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    min-width: 60px;
}
.accordion-slider-row input[type="range"] {
    flex: 1;
    height: 2px;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    background: var(--border);
    border-radius: 2px;
    outline: none;
}
.accordion-slider-row input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent-blue);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}
.accordion-slider-row .slider-val {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--accent-blue);
    min-width: 28px;
    text-align: right;
}

/* ── Enhanced Slider Control (src/ui/sliderControl.js) ── */
.sc-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 2px 0;
    width: 100%;
}
.sc-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    width: 100%;
}
.sc-label {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    min-width: 92px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.sc-dna .sc-label {
    min-width: 104px;
}
.sc-bound {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    background: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 0 3px;
    height: 14px;
    line-height: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    min-width: 24px;
    text-align: center;
}
.sc-bound:hover {
    color: var(--accent-gold);
    border-color: var(--accent-gold);
}
.sc-zoomed .sc-bound {
    color: var(--accent-orange);
    border-color: var(--accent-orange);
}
.sc-input {
    flex: 1;
    height: 2px;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    background: var(--border);
    border-radius: 2px;
    outline: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    min-width: 40px;
}
.sc-input::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent-blue);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}
.sc-input::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent-blue);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}
.sc-value {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--accent-blue);
    min-width: 40px;
    text-align: right;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.sc-mode {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 7px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    background: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 0 3px;
    height: 14px;
    line-height: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.sc-mode.is-log {
    color: var(--accent-gold);
    border-color: var(--accent-gold);
}
.sc-mode:disabled {
    opacity: 0.3;
    cursor: default;
}
.sc-zoom {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 7px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    background: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 0 3px;
    height: 14px;
    line-height: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    min-width: 18px;
}
.sc-zoom.is-zoomed {
    color: var(--accent-orange);
    border-color: var(--accent-orange);
}
.sc-edit {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--accent-gold);
    background: var(--bg-tertiary);
    border: 1px solid var(--accent-gold);
    border-radius: 3px;
    width: 44px;
    padding: 0 2px;
    height: 14px;
}
.sc-zoombar {
    position: relative;
    height: 2px;
    background: var(--border);
    opacity: 0.5;
    border-radius: 1px;
}
.sc-zoombar-fill {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: var(--accent-blue);
    border-radius: 1px;
    transition: left 120ms ease, width 120ms ease;
}
.sc-zoomed .sc-zoombar {
    opacity: 1;
}
.sc-zoomed .sc-zoombar-fill {
    background: var(--accent-orange);
}

/* ── DNA Analytics ── */
#dna-analytics { padding: 6px 8px; }
.analytics-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.analytics-card {
    flex: 1;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 6px;
}
.analytics-card h4 {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.bar-container { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
.bar-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.bar-label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 7px; color: var(--text-dim); min-width: 30px; }
.bar-track { flex: 1; height: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; }
.bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 2px; transition: width 0.3s ease; }
.bar-value { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 7px; color: var(--text-dim); min-width: 24px; text-align: right; }

/* ── DNA Fingerprint Grid ── */
.dna-fingerprint-grid { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.fingerprint-species { flex: 1; min-width: 100px; }
.fingerprint-label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 7px; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.fingerprint-bars { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 1px; height: 40px; }
.fp-bar { width: 3px; min-height: 1px; border-radius: 1px; }

/* ── Genetic Diversity Table ── */
.diversity-metrics { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 7px; }
.diversity-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.diversity-table th { color: var(--text-secondary); text-align: left; padding: 2px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.diversity-table td { padding: 2px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }
.het-bar-track { display: inline-block; width: 60px; height: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; vertical-align: middle; }
.het-bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 2px; transition: width 0.3s ease; }
.het-value { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 7px; color: var(--text-dim); margin-left: 4px; }



/* ── Chart sections ── */
#dna-charts { padding: 0 8px 8px; }
.chart-section { margin-top: 8px; }
.chart-title {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    color: var(--accent-red);
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
}
#pop-line-graph, #mass-nrg-scatter {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100px;
    background: #000;
    border: 1px solid #222;
    display: block;
    border-radius: var(--radius);
}
#mass-nrg-scatter { height: 120px; }

/* ── LOG Panel ── */
#narrative-log { padding: 4px 8px; max-height: 200px; overflow-y: auto; }
.log-entry {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    padding: 3px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ── Settings/Laws Panel ── */
#laws-panel { padding: 4px; }
.law-section {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.law-section-header {
    padding: 5px 8px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.law-grid-inner {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 4px;
}
.law-btn {
    padding: 4px 2px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    color: var(--text-dim);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    text-align: center;
}
.law-btn:hover { border-color: var(--text-secondary); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.law-btn.active { color: #000; font-weight: bold; }

/* ── Scrollbar ── */
#main-panel .tab-content::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 3px; }
#main-panel .tab-content::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
#main-panel .tab-content::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border); border-radius: 2px; }


/* ── Law Info Module (above law grid) ──────────────────────── */.law-info-module {
  width: 100%;
  height: 96px;
  min-height: 96px;
  max-height: 96px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  background: rgba(8, 8, 16, 0.85);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  overflow: hidden;
  contain: layout;
}
.law-info-module.hidden { display: none; }
.law-info-module .info-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 10px;
  height: 100%;
}
.law-info-module .info-icon {
  font-size: 28px;
  line-height: 1;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 32px;
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.law-info-module .info-body {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 100%;
  overflow-y: auto;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}
.law-info-module .info-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
  font-weight: bold;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  background: rgba(8, 8, 16, 0.96);
  padding-bottom: 2px;
}
.law-info-module .info-title {
  /* --text-primary: `var(--text)` is not defined in this codebase, so the
   * original declaration was invalid and silently inherited its colour. */
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 15px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.law-info-module .info-category {
  font-size: 11px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  opacity: 1;
  font-weight: bold;
}
.law-info-module .info-close {
  margin-left: auto;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 0 2px;
}
.law-info-module .info-close:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
/* Law info contrast raised. The system formula was rgba(255,255,255,0.35) on
 * near-black — roughly 3:1 against the panel, below the WCAG AA threshold for
 * body text, and at 8px it was effectively decorative. The formula is the most
 * valuable line in the panel (it is the actual law), so it now reads clearly. */
.law-info-module .info-hint {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.law-info-module .info-explanation {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.law-info-module .info-system {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  font-style: italic;
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle {
  margin-left: auto;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 2px 4px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle .toggle-track {
  width: 24px;
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  position: relative;
  transition: background 0.2s;
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle.on .toggle-track {
  background: var(--accent-green);
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle.off .toggle-track {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle .toggle-knob {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1px;
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff;
  transition: left 0.2s;
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle.on .toggle-knob {
  left: 13px;
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle.off .toggle-knob {
  left: 1px;
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle .toggle-label {
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle.on .toggle-label {
  color: var(--accent-green);
}
.law-info-module .info-toggle.off .toggle-label {
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

/* ── Chaos Menu ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.chaos-menu {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 10000;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.chaos-menu-content {
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.97);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-red);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 16px;
  min-width: 240px;
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
}
.chaos-menu-title {
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-align: center;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.chaos-menu-cats {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.chaos-cat-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}
.chaos-cat-row:hover { background: rgba(255,74,74,0.1); }
.chaos-cat-row input[type="checkbox"] {
  accent-color: var(--accent-red);
}
.chaos-menu-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.chaos-btn-action {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 60px;
  background: rgba(255,74,74,0.1);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-red);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--accent-red);
  padding: 6px 8px;
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  font-size: 9px;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: center;
  transition: all 0.15s;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.chaos-btn-action:hover {
  background: rgba(255,74,74,0.25);
}

/* ── View Mode Toggle ───────────────────────────────────────── */
.view-mode-toggle {
  margin-left: auto;
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.6);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 2px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  font-size: 9px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  transition: all 0.15s;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.view-mode-toggle:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-blue);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.view-mode-toggle.word-mode {
  border-color: var(--accent-blue);
  color: var(--accent-blue);
}
.view-mode-toggle.active {
  border-color: var(--accent-blue);
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  background: rgba(74,158,255,0.10);
  box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(74,158,255,0.2);
}
.law-mode-icon {
  min-width: 22px;
  text-align: center;
  margin-left: auto;
}
.view-mode-toggle.law-mode-abc {
  margin-left: 0;
}

/* Word-mode law grid items */
.sq-toggle-word {
  width: auto !important;
  height: 24px !important;
  padding: 0 6px;
  gap: 4px;
  justify-content: flex-start !important;
  font-size: 9px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.sq-toggle-word .tog-icon {
  font-size: 11px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.sq-toggle-word .tog-name {
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
#law-grid.word-mode {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 6px;
}
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 5px 6px;
  font-size: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  text-align: left;
}
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn .tog-icon {
  font-size: 11px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  line-height: 1;
}
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn .tog-name {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
/* Category-coloured icons in list mode (dim when inactive, bright when active) */
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn .tog-icon { color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 80%) 74%); }
/* Active list-mode laws get the full spectrum accent (matches icon mode) */
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn.active { border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 95%) 62%); background: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 85%) 55% / 0.15); box-shadow: 0 0 6px hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 85%) 60% / 0.2); color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 95%) 85%); }
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn { border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 65%) 50% / 0.28); }
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  #law-grid.word-mode { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
}

/* ── Responsive ── */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .toolbar-center { gap: 6px; }
    .hud-population-orb::before { width: 5px; height: 5px; flex-basis: 5px; }
    .hud-population-orb::after { font-size: 7px; }
    .hud-tick-compact {
    display: inline-block;
    white-space: pre-line;
    line-height: 1.05;
    min-width: 52px; }
    .law-icon-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(26px, 1fr)); }
    .law-grid-inner { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
}

/* ── DNA Tab Expanded Charts ── */

#dna-charts {
    padding: 6px;
}

.chart-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.chart-row .chart-section {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
}

.chart-section {
    background: #0a0a0f;
    border: 1px solid #1a1a2a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.chart-title {
    font-size: 7px;
    color: #555;
    margin: 0 0 3px 0;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.chart-section canvas {
    width: 100%;
    height: 80px;
    display: block;
}

.dna-section-title {
    font-size: 8px;
    color: #888;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    margin: 4px 0;
    padding-bottom: 2px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #1a1a2a;
}

/* ── DNA Analytics Stats ── */

.dna-stat-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 1px 0;
    font-size: 7px;
}

.dna-stat-label {
    width: 50px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    color: #888;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.dna-stat-bar-bg {
    flex: 1;
    height: 8px;
    background: #111;
    border-radius: 2px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.dna-stat-bar {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 2px;
    transition: width 0.3s;
}

.dna-stat-val {
    width: 50px;
    text-align: right;
    color: #aaa;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Tap-to-copy diagnostic banners */
[data-copyable]::after {
    content: ' ⧉ tap to copy';
    opacity: 0.7;
    font-weight: normal;
}
[data-copyable]:active {
    filter: brightness(1.4);
}

/* Settings panel */
.setting-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 4px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
}
.setting-label {
    flex: 0 0 45%;
    font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace);
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    color: #9ab;
}
#cam-reset {
    margin: 6px 0;
}

/* ── v4: World Intelligence Panel ── */
.world-intel {
  margin-top: 14px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-top: 10px;
}
.intel-header {
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.intel-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.intel-cell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
}
.intel-label {
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.intel-value {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: var(--accent-green);
}
.intel-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  align-items: center;
}
.intel-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.intel-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent-purple); color: var(--accent-purple); }
.intel-btn.recording { color: var(--accent-red); border-color: var(--accent-red); }
#intel-scrub {
  flex: 1;
  accent-color: var(--accent-purple);
}
/* ── Group analytics (Set F.4 — civilizations dashboard) ── */
.ga-canvas {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(120, 140, 200, 0.18);
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgba(6, 10, 22, 0.55);
}
.intel-log {
  margin-top: 6px;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  white-space: pre-line;
  max-height: 64px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

/* ── v4: Debug overlay ── */
.vepa-debug {
  position: fixed;
  top: 4px;
  left: 4px;
  z-index: 99999;
  width: min(640px, calc(100vw - 8px));
  background: rgba(10, 10, 14, 0.92);
  border: 1px solid #555;
  border-radius: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #ddd;
}
.vepa-debug.hidden { display: none; }
.vepa-debug-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #444;
}
.vepa-debug-dot { color: #4aff8a; font-size: 10px; }
.vepa-debug-title { color: #4aff8a; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.vepa-debug-version { color: #9adc9a; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.vepa-debug-count { color: #ffd700; font-weight: bold; }
.vepa-debug-stats {
  flex: 1;
  color: #888;
  text-align: right;
  font-size: 10px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.vepa-debug-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid #666;
  color: #ccc;
  font: 10px var(--font-mono);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.vepa-debug-btn:hover { border-color: #4aff8a; color: #4aff8a; }
.vepa-debug-btn.dbg-copied { color: #060; background: #4aff8a; border-color: #4aff8a; }
.vepa-debug-body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 6px 8px;
  max-height: 45vh;
  overflow: auto;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: break-all;
}
.vepa-debug-body .dbg-error { color: #ff6a6a; }
.vepa-debug-body .dbg-warn  { color: #ffd700; }
.vepa-debug-body .dbg-info  { color: #9adc9a; }

/* ============================================================
   VEPA4 — PIZZAZ (atmosphere & micro-interactions)
   Added 2026-08-02
   ============================================================ */

/* ── CRT scanline texture over the simulation viewport ── */
#app::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 5;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.028) 0px,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.028) 1px,
        transparent 1px,
        transparent 3px
    );
}

/* ── Top toolbar: drop shadow + animated accent sheen ── */
#top-toolbar {
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.15), 0 6px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
}
#top-toolbar::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: -1px;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent-blue) 35%, var(--accent-red) 65%, transparent);
    opacity: 0.5;
    animation: toolbar-sheen 7s ease-in-out infinite;
    pointer-events: none;
}
@keyframes toolbar-sheen {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.2; }
    50% { opacity: 0.75; }
}

/* ── Toolbar buttons: hover glow + pulse on active ── */
#top-toolbar .sq-btn:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.35);
    transform: translateY(-1px);
}
#top-toolbar .sq-btn:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.94); }
#top-toolbar .sq-btn.active {
    animation: pulse-orange 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes pulse-orange {
    0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(255, 138, 74, 0.25); }
    50% { box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255, 138, 74, 0.55); }
}
#chaos-btn:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 74, 74, 0.4);
}

/* ── Tab bar: glowing active underline ── */
#main-panel .tab-btn.active {
    text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 74, 74, 0.65);
}
#main-panel .tab-btn:hover { text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); }

/* ── HUD: color-coded live stats ── */
.hud-particles {
    color: var(--accent-blue);
    text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.5);
}
.hud-species {
    color: var(--accent-purple);
    text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(180, 74, 255, 0.5);
}
.hud-tick { color: var(--text-secondary); }
.hud-tick-compact { font-variant-caps: all-small-caps; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }

/* ── Law toggles: gentle glow pulse on active ── */
.law-btn.active.physics,
.law-btn.active.biology,
.law-btn.active.chemistry,
.law-btn.active.thermodynamics,
.law-btn.active.metaphysics {
    animation: law-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes law-pulse {
    0%, 100% { filter: brightness(1); }
    50% { filter: brightness(1.25); }
}

/* ── Drawer: subtle red glow above the tab strip ── */
#main-panel .drawer-minimize-btn,
#main-panel .drawer-hide-btn {
    font-weight: 700;
}

/* ── Chaos Multiplex ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#multiplex-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 40;
  display: none;
  padding: 10px;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(20,20,35,0.9), rgba(5,5,12,0.97));
}
#multiplex-overlay.active { display: flex; }
#multiplex-grid {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  width: 100%;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}
.shard-cell {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #07070d;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
.shard-cell::after {
  content: attr(data-shard-label);
  position: absolute;
  top: 5px;
  left: 8px;
  z-index: 2;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
  pointer-events: none;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 3px #000;
}
.shard-cell.selected {
  border-color: var(--accent-red);
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255,74,74,0.55), inset 0 0 22px rgba(255,74,74,0.10);
}
.shard-canvas {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  touch-action: none;
  cursor: crosshair;
}

/* Bottom multiplex controls bar (all settings live in the setup screen) */
#multiplex-drawer {
  z-index: 45;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}
#multiplex-drawer.hidden { display: none; }

/* Minimized: slim strip — icon-only iterate button stays visible */
#multiplex-drawer .mpx-strip {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 4px 14px;
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease;
}
#multiplex-drawer .mpx-strip:hover { border-color: var(--accent-red); }
#multiplex-drawer .mpx-chevron {
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}
#multiplex-drawer.expanded .mpx-strip { display: none; }

/* Expanded body */
#multiplex-drawer .mpx-body {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  width: auto;
  min-width: 340px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-red);
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 18px rgba(255,74,74,0.18);
}
#multiplex-drawer.expanded .mpx-body { display: flex; }
.mpx-body-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.mpx-title {
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
}
.mpx-stat {
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.mpx-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-left: auto;
}
.mpx-btn {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.mpx-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent-red); color: var(--accent-red); }
.mpx-icon {
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.mpx-action {
  padding: 8px 10px;
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  background: rgba(255,74,74,0.10);
  border-color: rgba(255,74,74,0.5);
  color: var(--accent-red);
}
.mpx-action:hover { background: rgba(255,74,74,0.22); }
.mpx-danger { background: rgba(255,74,74,0.16); }

/* ── Live settings inside the right-edge drawer ── */
.mpx-settings {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 8px 0;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.mpx-settings-title {
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: var(--accent-red);
  opacity: 0.85;
}
.mpx-set-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.mpx-set-label { flex: 0 0 auto; }
.mpx-set-value {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 8px;
}
.mpx-set-row input[type="range"] {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  accent-color: var(--accent-red);
  height: 12px;
}
.mpx-checks { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-left: auto; }
.mpx-check {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.mpx-check input { accent-color: var(--accent-red); }
.mpx-num {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
}
.mpx-num input {
  width: 30px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  padding: 2px 3px;
}
.mpx-set-row select {
  margin-left: auto;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  padding: 2px 4px;
}

/* ── Multiplex drawer tabs + FIT panel (v4.6.24) ── */
.mpx-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-bottom: 4px;
}
.mpx-tab {
  flex: 1;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  padding: 4px 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.mpx-tab:hover { color: var(--accent-red); border-color: rgba(255,74,74,0.5); }
.mpx-tab.active {
  background: rgba(255,74,74,0.14);
  border-color: var(--accent-red);
  color: var(--accent-red);
}
.mpx-panel { display: none; }
.mpx-panel.active { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }

/* Fitness metric rows */
.mpx-fit-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.mpx-fit-label {
  flex: 0 0 52px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.mpx-fit-row input[type="range"] {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  accent-color: var(--accent-red);
  height: 12px;
}
.mpx-fit-pct {
  flex: 0 0 30px;
  text-align: right;
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 8px;
}
.mpx-mode {
  flex: 0 0 32px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 2px 0;
}
.mpx-mode:hover { border-color: var(--accent-red); color: var(--accent-red); }
.mpx-fit-title {
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: var(--accent-red);
  opacity: 0.85;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.mpx-fit-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  max-height: 180px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 4px;
}
.mpx-fit-shard {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  padding: 2px 4px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.mpx-fit-shard:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }
.mpx-fit-shard.selected {
  background: rgba(255,74,74,0.14);
  color: var(--accent-red);
}
.mpx-fit-shard span { color: var(--text-primary); }

/* ── Multiplex metrics top drawer ── */
#mpx-metrics {
  z-index: 60;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
#mpx-metrics > * { pointer-events: auto; }
.mpx-metrics-toggle {
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.85);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,74,74,0.5);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.mpx-metrics-toggle:hover { background: rgba(255,74,74,0.16); }
.mpx-metrics-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  max-width: 92vw;
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.9);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,74,74,0.4);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 6px 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}
#mpx-metrics.collapsed .mpx-metrics-body { display: none; }
.mpx-metrics-chips {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px;
  justify-content: center;
}
.mpx-metric-chip {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.mpx-metric-chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent-red); color: var(--accent-red); }
.mpx-metric-chip.selected {
  background: rgba(255,74,74,0.16);
  border-color: var(--accent-red);
  color: var(--accent-red);
}
.mpx-metrics-stats {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-align: center;
}

/* Chaos Multiplex settings modal */
#chaos-modal {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
}
#chaos-modal.open { display: flex; }
.chaos-modal-panel {
  width: 400px;
  max-width: 94vw;
  max-height: 92vh;
  overflow: auto;
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.98);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-red);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.8), 0 0 26px rgba(255,74,74,0.22);
}
.chaos-modal-title {
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.chaos-modal-sub {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.chaos-modal-section {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 12px 0;
}
.chaos-modal-label {
  color: var(--accent-gold);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.chaos-grid-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
.chaos-grid-row label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 10px;
}
.chaos-grid-row input[type="number"] {
  width: 52px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  padding: 5px 6px;
}
.chaos-grid-row input[type="number"]:focus { border-color: var(--accent-red); }
.chaos-grid-count {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.chaos-check,
.chaos-radio {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 4px 0;
}
.chaos-check input[type="checkbox"],
.chaos-radio input[type="radio"] {
  accent-color: var(--accent-red);
}
.chaos-check:hover,
.chaos-radio:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
#mpx-variation {
  width: 100%;
  accent-color: var(--accent-red);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.chaos-variation-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
#mpx-variation-value { color: var(--accent-red); }
.mpx-modal-fit {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}
.chaos-modal-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 14px;
}
.chaos-modal-actions .mpx-action { flex: 1; }

/* ── Law category rows (one row per law type) ─────────────────── */
.law-icon-grid,
#law-grid.word-mode { display: block; padding: 4px; }
.law-cat-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  padding: 4px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
}
.law-cat-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.law-cat-label {
  width: 100%;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  opacity: 0.75;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.law-cat-row .sq-toggle {
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  flex: 0 0 30px;
  font-size: 11px;
}
#law-grid.word-mode .law-cat-row .law-btn {
  width: auto;
  flex: 1 1 82px;
}
#law-grid.hidden { display: none; }

/* ── Dull spectrum tint when a law is OFF (icon mode) ── */
.law-icon-grid .sq-toggle { border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 65%) 50% / 0.30); color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 80%) 74% / 0.55); background: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 70%) 50% / 0.05); }

/* ── Dull spectrum tint when a law is OFF (list mode) ── */
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn { color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 80%) 74% / 0.60); }
/* Active list-mode icons inherit the bright button colour */
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn.active .tog-icon { color: inherit; }

/* ── Exclusive view-mode group ── */
.view-mode-group { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; margin-left: auto; }
.view-mode-group .view-mode-toggle { margin-left: 0; }
.view-mode-toggle.law-mode-icon { min-width: 24px; text-align: center; }

/* ── Law set bar (save / load presets) ── */
.law-set-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 6px 8px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  position: relative;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.law-set-btn {
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.6);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 2px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s;
}
.law-set-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent-blue); color: var(--accent-blue); }
.law-set-selector {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  text-align: left;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--accent-gold);
  font-size: 8px;
}
.law-set-selector:hover { border-color: var(--accent-blue); color: var(--accent-gold); }
.law-set-icon {
  width: 26px;
  padding: 3px 0;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  flex: none;
}
.law-set-dropdown {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  left: 8px;
  right: 8px;
  top: calc(100% - 4px);
  z-index: 50;
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.99);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-blue);
  border-radius: 4px;
  max-height: 40vh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 4px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
}
.law-set-dropdown.open { display: block; }
.law-set-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.12s;
}
.law-set-row:hover { background: rgba(74,158,255,0.12); }
.law-set-row.selected { background: rgba(255,215,0,0.10); }
.law-set-check {
  width: 10px;
  flex: none;
  color: var(--accent-gold);
  font-size: 9px;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
}
.law-set-mini-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 1px;
}
.law-set-mini-icon {
  width: 13px;
  height: 13px;
  flex: 0 0 13px;
  font-size: 8px;
  line-height: 13px;
  text-align: center;
  border-radius: 2px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
}
.law-set-mini-icon { color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 90%) 80% / 0.95); border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 70%) 55% / 0.5); }
.law-set-row-name {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.law-set-editor {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  align-items: center;
  flex: 1 1 100%;
}
.law-set-editor.hidden { display: none; }
.law-set-editor input {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-blue);
  border-radius: 2px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  padding: 3px 6px;
}
.law-set-editor button {
  background: rgba(74,158,255,0.12);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-blue);
  border-radius: 2px;
  color: var(--accent-blue);
  font-size: 11px;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}
.law-set-editor button:hover { background: rgba(74,158,255,0.25); }

/* ── Compact category rows (labels removed — filters carry the colour) ── */
.law-cat-label { display: none; }
.law-cat-row {
  padding: 2px 0;
  gap: 2px;
  border-bottom: none;
}

/* Small slate divider between the pinned Mechanics row and the rainbow rows */
.law-cat-divider {
  height: 1px;
  margin: 3px 2px;
  background: hsl(210 7% 55% / 0.30);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ── EM-spectrum law rainbow — all 8 categories, hue-driven ── */
.law-icon-grid .sq-toggle { border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 65%) 50% / 0.30); color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 80%) 74% / 0.55); background: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 70%) 50% / 0.05); }
.law-icon-grid .sq-toggle.active { border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 95%) 62%); background: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 85%) 55% / 0.15); box-shadow: 0 0 6px hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 85%) 60% / 0.25); color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 95%) 85%); }
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn { color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 80%) 74% / 0.60); }
#law-grid.word-mode .law-btn.active { border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 95%) 62%); background: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 85%) 55% / 0.15); box-shadow: 0 0 6px hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 85%) 60% / 0.2); color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 95%) 85%); }
.law-set-mini-icon { color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 90%) 80% / 0.95); border-color: hsl(var(--law-h, 210) var(--law-s, 70%) 55% / 0.5); }

/* ── Multiplex long-press tooltips (v4.6.28) ── */
#mpx-tooltip {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 130;
  max-width: 280px;
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.97);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-red);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.8), 0 0 18px rgba(255,74,74,0.25);
}
#mpx-tooltip.hidden { display: none; }
.mpx-tip-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-bottom: 5px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.mpx-tip-title {
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
}
.mpx-tip-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
.mpx-tip-guide,
.mpx-tip-close {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.mpx-tip-guide:hover,
.mpx-tip-close:hover { border-color: var(--accent-red); color: var(--accent-red); }
.mpx-tip-hint {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.mpx-tip-expl {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* ? help button in the controls drawer */
.mpx-header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.mpx-help-btn {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: bold;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border-color: rgba(255,74,74,0.5);
  color: var(--accent-red);
}

/* ── Full-screen multiplex guide (v4.6.28) ── */
#mpx-help-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 120;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.78);
  padding: 16px;
}
#mpx-help-overlay.hidden { display: none; }
.mpx-help-panel {
  width: 560px;
  max-width: 96vw;
  max-height: 92vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: rgba(8,8,16,0.98);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-red);
  border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 44px rgba(0,0,0,0.85), 0 0 26px rgba(255,74,74,0.22);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.mpx-help-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.mpx-help-title {
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
}
.mpx-help-sub {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  padding: 10px 16px 0;
}
.mpx-help-sections {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 8px 16px 16px;
}
.mpx-help-section { margin-top: 12px; }
.mpx-help-section-label {
  color: var(--accent-gold);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-bottom: 4px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.mpx-help-item {
  padding: 6px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
}
.mpx-help-item-title {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.mpx-help-item-hint {
  color: var(--accent-red);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.mpx-help-item-expl {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 8px;
  line-height: 1.6;
````
